usage.on.p1.html: Ko hoʻo palani ʻoku ʻi ai ha ngataʻanga ʻe ua: ko e taha ki he sēsini houa ʻe 5 mo e taha ki he uike. ʻIkai ha ngataʻanga fakamāhina. ʻE hā ʻi heni ʻa e ngaahi mita lalahi ʻe ua "% toe" ʻi he taimi pē ʻe hoko mai ai e lau ʻuluaki.

gloss.intro: Ko e ngaahi lea ʻoku ngāueʻaki ʻe he kau tohi polokalama (mo e ngaahi timi AI), ʻi he lea faingofua.
gloss.switch.help: Ko e ngaahi lea ʻoku ʻi ai ha laine toti ʻi lalo ʻoku nau ʻomi ha fakamatala faingofua ʻi he taimi ʻokú ke tuku ai e māusi ki ai.
gloss.backlog.text: Ko e lisi tatali ʻo e ngaahi fakakaukau mo e ngāue ʻoku teʻeki palani, mo e mahuʻinga taha ʻi ʻolunga. ʻE ʻikai ngāue ki ha meʻa ai kae ʻoua ke ʻave ia ki he Ke fai.
gloss.sprint.text: Ko ha vahaʻa ngāue nounou mo tuʻumaʻu (ʻoku faʻa ko e uike ʻe taha pe ua, ʻikai laka ʻi he mahina) mo ha taumuʻa mo ha ngaahi kaati kuo loto taha ke fakaʻosi.
gloss.standup.text: Ko ha fetuʻutaki vave ʻi he ʻaho kotoa: ko e hā naʻe fai ʻe he mēmipa taki taha, ko e hā ʻe fai hoko, pea ko e hā ʻoku taʻofi kinautolu. ʻI he Scrum ʻoku ui ia ko e daily scrum.
gloss.bug.text: Ko ha meʻa ʻoku ʻikai ngāue ʻo hangē ko e meʻa ʻoku totonu ke ngāue ai.
gloss.test.text: Ko ha sivi pe ʻoku ngāue ha meʻa ʻo hangē ko e totonu. Ko e niʻihi ʻoku lele ʻe he komipiuta ʻiate ia pē he taimi kotoa ʻoku liliu ai e koti; ko e niʻihi ko hoʻo feinga ia ki ha kaati kuo ʻosi kimuʻa pea ke tali.
gloss.commit.text: Ko ha tā kuo tauhi ʻo e koti, mo ha fakamatala nounou ʻo e meʻa naʻe liliu. Te ke lava maʻu pē ʻo foki ki ha taha.
gloss.push.text: Ko hono fekau hoʻo ngaahi tā kuo tauhi (commits) mei he komipiuta ni ki he kopi vahevahe ʻi he laine, hangē ko e GitHub, ke tauhi ia pea lava ʻe he kakai kehe ʻo maʻu.
gloss.branch.text: Ko ha laine ngāue kehe ʻi he koti, ke lava ʻo fai ha ngaahi liliu taʻe ala ki he paaki tefito.
gloss.merge.text: Ko hono fakatahaʻi e ngaahi liliu mei ha branch ʻe taha ki ha taha kehe, ʻoku faʻa foki ki he veesini tefito.
gloss.repo.text: Ko e folda ʻo e koti ʻo e poloseki mo hono hisitōlia kakato ʻo e ngaahi commit. ʻE lava ke ʻi hoʻo komipiuta, ʻi he GitHub, pe ʻi he ongo feituʻu.
gloss.refactor.text: Fakamaʻa e koti taʻe liliu e meʻa ʻoku ne fai: ngaahi fail siʻi ange, ngaahi hingoa mahino ange, siʻi ange ʻa e toe fakahoko.
gloss.deploy.text: Ko hono kopi ʻo ha veesini foʻou ʻo e polokalama ki he ngaahi komipiuta ʻoku fakalele ia, hangē ko ha kopi sivi pe ko e sēvesi ʻi he laine.
gloss.kanban.text: Ko ha founga ngāue ʻoku ʻalu ai e ngaahi kaati ʻi he ngaahi kolomu ʻo ha laupapa (hangē ko e Ke fai, ʻOku fakahoko, Kuo fai) pea ʻoku fakangatangata ʻe he timi e lahi ʻoku fakahoko he taimi tatau, ke tafe maʻu pē e ngāue.
gloss.wip.text: Ko e WIP ko e nounou ia ʻo e work in progress (ngāue ʻoku fakahoko). Ko e WIP limit ko e lahi taha ʻo e ngaahi kaati ʻe lava ke tauhi ʻe ha kolomu he taimi tatau, ke fakaʻosi ʻe he timi e ngaahi meʻa kimuʻa pea kamata ha toe.
gloss.pr.text: Ko hono kole ke vakaiʻi mo fakatahaʻi e ngaahi liliu ʻo ha branch ki he veesini tefito. Ko e niʻihi ʻo e ngaahi uepisaiti ʻoku nau ui ia ko e merge request.
gloss.hook.text: Ko ha fekau siʻisiʻi ʻoku lele ʻiate ia ʻi ha taimi kuo fokotuʻu, hangē ko e kamata ʻa ha sēsini AI, ke fanongo ʻa e timi ki hoʻo ngaahi fakamatala.
gloss.token.text: Ko e ngaahi konga siʻi ʻo e tohi ʻoku lau mo tohi ʻe ha AI, taki taha ʻoku ofi ki he tolu hono fā ʻo ha lea. Ko e ngāueʻaki AI ʻoku lau ʻaki e ngaahi token, ko ia ko e token siʻi ange ʻoku toe ai e lahi ange ʻo hoʻo palani.
gloss.agent.text: Ko ha AI ʻoku ngāue ki ha ngāue ʻiate ia pē: ʻoku lau e koti, fai ha ngaahi liliu, lele ha ngaahi sivi pea lipooti mai. ʻOku kei vakaiʻi hono ngāue.
tour.btn.title: Ko ha takai nounou ʻi he laupapa
tour.intro: Ko ha ngaahi tuʻunga ʻe niʻihi ʻi he laupapa. Ko e hā e lahi ʻoku ke loto ki ai?
tour.lvl.new.help: Tuʻunga kotoa, mo e ʻuhinga ʻoku ngāue pehē ai. ʻOku fakamatala foki e ngaahi lea makehe.
tour.lvl.refresh.help: Ngaahi tuʻunga lalahi, ʻi he laine taki taha.
tour.welcome.title: Talitali fiefia ki he AI-gile
tour.welcome.text: Ko ha laupapa ʻoku fai ai ʻe he ngaahi timi AI e ngāue pea ko koe ʻoku fili, sivi mo fakamoʻoni. Ko e founga eni ke ke ʻilo ai e feituʻu.
tour.welcome.short: Ko ha takai vave ʻo e laupapa.
tour.welcome.why: Ko e fakakaukau: ʻoku fai ʻe he ngaahi timi e ngāue faingataʻa siʻi, pea ʻoku ke sio pē ki he meʻa ʻoku fiemaʻu ha tangata.
tour.rail.title: Hoʻo ngaahi poloseki
tour.rail.text: ʻApi, hoʻo puha fakamatala, talanoa mo e kau taki, pea ko e ʻaikoni ʻe taha ki he poloseki taki taha. Ko e taimana viole ʻoku ʻuhinga ia ʻoku ʻi ai ha meʻa ʻoku tatali kiate koe. Toho e ngaahi ʻaikoni ke tuku ʻi hoʻo fakamālie.
tour.rail.short: Ngaahi poloseki ʻi he laine (ʻi lalo ʻi ha telefoni); ko e ngaahi taimana lanu viole ʻoku ʻuhinga ʻoku ʻi ai ha meʻa ʻoku tatali kiate koe.
tour.rail.why: Ko e sio pē taha ʻoku ne tala atu ʻa e feituʻu ʻoku fiemaʻu ai koe, taʻe fakaava ha meʻa.
tour.inbox.title: Hoʻo puha fakamatala
tour.inbox.text: Ko e meʻa kotoa ʻoku tatali kiate koe, ʻi he ngaahi poloseki kotoa: ngaahi fehuʻi, ngaahi ngāue ʻe lava pē ʻe koe ʻo fai, mo e ngaahi meʻa ke sivi. Lomi ha chip ke sio ki he faʻahinga pē ko ia.
tour.inbox.short: Ko e meʻa kotoa ʻoku tatali kiate koe, ʻi he feituʻu kotoa. Lomi ha chip ki ha faʻahinga ʻe taha.
tour.inbox.why: ʻOku ʻikai totonu ke ke ō ki he poloseki kotoa ke ʻilo e meʻa ʻoku fiemaʻu koe.
tour.foryou.title: Maʻau
tour.foryou.text: ʻI ha laupapa, ko e kolomu ni ʻoku ne ʻi ai e meʻa ʻoku tatali kiate koe ʻi he poloseki ko ia. Fakaava ha sivi, muimui ki hono ngaahi sitepu, pea Fakamoʻoni pe Fakafoki mo ha ʻuhinga.
tour.foryou.short: Ko e fokotuʻunga kaati ʻo e poloseki ni maʻau: sivi, pea Fakamoʻoni pe Fakafoki.
tour.foryou.why: ʻOku ʻikai fakaʻosi ʻe he ngaahi timi ʻenau ngāue ʻanautolu: ko koe ʻoku fakamoʻoni. ʻOku ne tauhi e tuʻunga lelei ʻi hoʻo nima.
tour.chat.title: Talanoa mo e kau taki
tour.chat.text: Fekau ha fakamatala ki he taki ʻo ha poloseki mo ha fakakaukau pe fehuʻi. ʻOku nau liliu e ngaahi fakakaukau ki he ngaahi kaati mo ha palani nounou, mo e ngaahi fakamau Fai maʻau.
tour.chat.short: Fekau ha fakamatala ki ha taki; te nau palani pea ke lomi Fai.
tour.chat.why: ʻIkai ha meʻa ʻe langa kae ʻoua ke ke pehē Fai: ko koe ʻoku pule ki he meʻa ʻoku hoko.
tour.setup.title: Fokotuʻu
tour.setup.text: Ho hingoa, lea, fōtunga mo e feituʻu ʻoku nofo ai e AI ʻi he komipiuta ni. ʻOku ʻi ai foki ha suiti ke fakamatala e ngaahi lea polokalama, mo e fakahinohino lea.
tour.setup.short: Ho ngaahi fokotuʻu, lea mo e tohi fakahā ʻo e ngaahi lea tekinikale. ʻI ha telefoni ʻoku ʻi lalo ʻi he lisi ʻi ʻolunga.
trial.h: 🧪 Feinga ko ha tokotaha ngāueʻaki foʻou
trial.help: Ko ha kopi foʻou, maha, ʻo e AI-gile ʻi hono uinitou ʻaʻana (localhost:4400), mo ha ngaahi poloseki fakatātā ʻe tolu ke kumi pea ko ha timi fakatātā ʻoku ne tali koe. Sio pe ko e hā e meʻa ʻoku sio ki ai ha kaumeʻa ʻi heʻene lele ʻuluaki. ʻIkai ala ki hoʻo laupapa moʻoni; ʻikai ha AI, ʻikai ha totongi.
standup.needs: 🙋 Fiemaʻu koe ({n}): ʻoku hokohoko atu e ngaahi timi
quiet.until.help: ʻIkai fiemaʻu. Tuku ia ke maha pea ʻe hokohoko atu ʻa e leʻo poʻuli kae ʻoua ke ke lomi ʻa e Foki pe kamata ho ʻaho.
watch.help: Lolotonga ʻokú ke mamaʻo ʻoku ne sivi e ngaahi poloseki ni ʻi he miniti ʻe 10 kotoa: ʻoku ne ueʻi e ngaahi timi ʻoku ʻi ai ʻenau ngāue, toe kamataʻi ha taha naʻe tuku ʻi he vahaʻa kaati, pea fakamaʻu ha kaati ko e pipiki hili ha feinga ʻe 3. ʻIkai ha totongi: ko e laupapa ʻoku fai, ʻikai ko ha AI.

Fakaʻauto ʻoku sivi foki ʻi he taimi ʻoku laka e lau fakamuimui ʻi ha houa. Tāpuni: ʻikai ha fakamau mo ha sivi.

dispatch.help: Ko hoʻo ngaahi fakamatala mo e ngaahi kaati foʻou ʻoku ʻalu ki he taki ka ʻikai te ke hingoa ha taha (@Hingoa) pe ko e kaati ko ha sivi. Ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni pē ʻoku ʻikai ui ha AI; Ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni + Haiku ʻoku fehuʻi ki he mōtēle siʻisiʻi taha ʻo tuʻo taha ʻi he taimi ʻoku ʻikai lava ʻe he ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni ʻo tala; Ko e taki ʻoku ne fili ʻoku ne ueʻi e taki ʻi he taimi kotoa. Ko e fili taki taha ʻoku hiki ʻi he lekooti ʻo e poloseki.
wz.btn.help: Miniti ʻe taha ʻo e ngaahi fehuʻi ʻoku ne fakahoa e AI-gile ki hoʻo pāseti mo hoʻo founga ngāue. Ko e meʻa kotoa ʻe lava pē ʻo liliu ʻi lalo.
wz.ask.sub: Te ke loto ki ha wizard vave ke fokotuʻu e ngaahi meʻa? ʻOku ne fakahoa e AI-gile ki hoʻo pāseti mo hoʻo founga ngāue, pea ʻoku toe ofi ki he miniti ʻe taha. Pe te ke lava ʻo kumi hoʻo founga ʻaʻau.
wz.need.name: Tānaki muʻa hoʻo hingoa, ke ʻilo ʻe he timi ʻa e hingoa ke ui koe.
wz.1.sub: ʻI he AI-gile, ʻoku ngāue e ngaahi tokoni AI ki hoʻo ngaahi kaati pea ʻokú ke vakaiʻi e meʻa naʻa nau fai. Ko ha ngaahi fehuʻi vave pē pea kuo mateuteu koe. Kuo fili hoʻo lea: liliu ia ʻi heni kapau ʻoku hala.
wz.2.h: Ko hai koe, pea ko e AI fē ʻokú ke ngāueʻaki?
wz.2.name: Ho hingoa
wz.2.name.help: Ko e hingoa ia ʻoku ui ai koe ʻe hoʻo ngaahi tokoni AI.
wz.2.agent.help: Ko e polokalama AI ʻoku kamataʻi ʻe he laupapa ʻi he taimi ʻoku ʻi ai ha ngāue maʻa hoʻo ngaahi tokoni. ʻOkú ke veiveiua? Tuku maha ia pea tānaki ia ʻi he Fokotuʻu ʻi ha taimi kimui.
wz.3.h: Ko e hā e founga ke ngāue ai hoʻo ngaahi tokoni AI mo koe?
wz.3.sub: Fili e taha ʻoku ofi taha. Te ke lava ʻo liliu e konga taki taha ʻo ia ʻi he Fokotuʻu ʻi ha taimi kimui.
wz.style.careful.help: Fehuʻi kimuʻa he langa kotoa, longolongo mo fakamaʻa, mālōlō he poʻuli.
wz.style.balanced.help: Fai pē e ngaahi meʻa siʻisiʻi, ha kiʻi ueʻi anga-lelei, mālōlō he poʻuli.
wz.style.fast.help: Fehuʻi siʻi, ko e ngāue pē, hokohoko atu he poʻuli.
wz.4.h: Ko e lahi fē e AI te ke lava ʻo ngāueʻaki?
wz.4.sub: Ko e meʻa ni ʻoku ne fokotuʻu e lahi ʻo hoʻo palani AI ʻe lava ke ngāueʻaki ʻe he laupapa, mo e lahi ʻo e ngaahi poloseki ʻe ngāue ki ai he taimi tatau. ʻOkú ke veiveiua? Fili Angamaheni.
wz.plan.fly.help: Poloseki ʻe taha he taimi tatau, ʻikai ha sivi ngāueʻaki.
wz.plan.careful.help: Poloseki ʻe ua he taimi tatau, ʻoku taʻofi ʻi he 60% ʻo hoʻo palani AI.
wz.plan.normal.help: Poloseki ʻe tolu he taimi tatau, ʻoku taʻofi ʻi he 90% ʻo hoʻo palani AI.
wz.plan.generous.help: Poloseki ʻe nima he taimi tatau, ʻoku sivi ʻe ia pē e ngāueʻaki.
wz.5.sub: Liliu ha meʻa ʻi he ⚙️ Fokotuʻu, pe toe lele e wizard.
wz.5.more: Ko ha puha ʻe niʻihi ʻi lalo ʻo e Fokotuʻu ʻoku kei maha; fakafonu pea tauhi.

help.start.3: Ko e "Maʻau" ko ho lisi: ko e ngaahi meʻa ʻoku tatali ki ho tali pe ho fakangofua. Vakai ki ai ʻi he taimi ni mo e taimi.
help.start.4: Ko e Ngaahi fakamatala (ko e pātone 💬 ʻi he ʻolunga ʻo e laine toʻohema) ʻoku ne fakaʻatā ke ke fetalanoaʻaki mo ha timi, pe kole ki ho tokoni fakafoʻituitui.
help.start.more: Te ke fie maʻu ha fakahinohino? Ngāueʻaki ʻa e Fai e takai ʻi he lisi ni, pe feinga ʻa e Founga Fakatātā ʻaki ha ngaahi poloseki fakatātā.

lkcall.btn.title: Fetuʻutaki leʻo pe vitiō mo {name}, mo e vahevahe sikilini
lkcall.notset: ʻOku te'eki fokotuʻu ʻa e ngaahi fetuʻutaki. Ke fetuʻutaki mo {name}, ʻoku fiemaʻu ʻe AI-gile ha sēvā LiveKit: ʻaʻau, pe ha poloseki LiveKit Cloud ʻoku ʻikai totongi. Fakaava ʻa e Fokotuʻu → Ngaahi fetuʻutaki pea fakapipiki ʻene ʻadresi, kī API mo e fakapulipuli API. Kapau kuo fokotuʻu ʻe {name} ʻene ngaahi fetuʻutaki, te ne lava ʻo fetuʻutaki kiate koe: ʻi he taimi te ne kamata ai ha fetuʻutaki, ʻe hū ʻa e pātone ni ki ai.
lkcall.nolib: ʻIkai lava ke ʻomi ʻa e polokalama fetuʻutaki (livekit-client). Vakai ki hoʻo initaneti pea feinga toe.
lkcall.wrongroom: Ko e tikite fetuʻutaki ko iá naʻe ki ha fetuʻutaki kehe, ko ia naʻe mavahe vave ai ʻa AI-gile. Kole ki ho kaumeʻa ke ne kamata toe ʻa e fetuʻutaki.
lkcall.set.help: Ko e ngaahi fetuʻutaki leʻo mo vitiō mo e vahevahe sikilini ʻi he talanoa ʻa e kaumeʻa ʻoku ʻalu ia ʻi ha sēvā LiveKit. Fakapipiki ʻene ʻadresi (wss://…), kī API mo e fakapulipuli API. Tauhi fakamaʻu ʻa e fakapulipuli ʻi he PC ni pea ʻikai toe hā. ʻOku ʻikai fiemaʻu ʻe ho kaumeʻa ha meʻa ʻaʻana: ʻi he taimi ʻokú ke kamata ai ha fetuʻutaki, ʻe maʻu ʻe ia ha tikite ke hū ai.

gloss.title: 📖 Ngaahi foʻi lea kuo fakamatalaʻi
gloss.about: Ko e akoʻanga taʻetotongi ʻi he lea faingofua: ko e lea kotoa ʻokú ke fetaulaki mo ia, mei ha fakakaukau ʻuluaki ki ha sēvesi ʻoku falala ki ai e kakai, mo e Agile, langa, tauhi malu mo e ngāue mo e AI ʻi he hala.
gloss.about.noai: Ko e akoʻanga taʻetotongi ʻi he lea faingofua: ko e lea kotoa ʻokú ke fetaulaki mo ia, mei ha fakakaukau ʻuluaki ki ha sēvesi ʻoku falala ki ai e kakai, mo e Agile, langa mo e tauhi malu ʻi he hala.
gloss.g.team: 🤝 Ngāue ko ha timi (pea mo e AI)
gloss.card.text: Ko ha konga ngāue ʻe taha: ha ngāue, ha bug pe ha fakakaukau. ʻOku ʻalu ia ʻi he ngaahi kolomu kae ʻoua ke ʻosi.
gloss.project.text: Ko ha laupapa ki ha meʻa ʻe taha ʻokú ke loto ke fakaʻosi, hangē ko ha app, ha fale ngāue ʻi he ngoue pe ha fononga. ʻOku ʻi ai ʻa e ngaahi kaati.
gloss.forteam.text: Ko e kolomu ki he ngaahi kaati ʻoku toe hoko ki he timi, hangē ko e hili ʻa hoʻo tali ʻenau fehuʻi pe kole ha liliu.
gloss.lead.also: ngaahi taki,taki ʻo e timi,lead,leads,team lead
gloss.lead.text: Ko e tokoni AI ʻoku ne tataki ha poloseki. ʻOku ne ʻave hoʻo ngaahi kaati, vahevahe e ngāue, pea fehuʻi kiate koe ʻi he taimi ʻoku fiemaʻu ai koe.
gloss.agentprog.text: Ko e polokalama AI ʻi hoʻo komipiuta, hangē ko e Claude Code, ʻoku kamataʻi ʻe he laupapa ʻi he taimi ʻoku ʻi ai ha ngāue maʻa hoʻo ngaahi tokoni.
gloss.dispatcher.text: Ko e konga ʻo e laupapa ʻoku ne lau ha kaati pe fakamatala foʻou pea fili pe ko hai ʻe ʻave ia. Ko e ngaahi lao faingofua ʻuluaki, pea ko ha AI siʻisiʻi ʻi he taimi pē ʻoku ʻikai ke mahino.
gloss.space.text: Ko ha kulupu ʻo e ngaahi poloseki ʻoku fekau ʻaki, hangē ko ha folda ki he ngaahi laupapa. ʻOku fakaʻilonga ʻe he 🪐 ha taha.
gloss.playground.text: Ko ha poloseki kuo teuteu ke ngāueʻaki ʻe ha kaumeʻa ke sivi ai ʻa e AI-gile, mo ha koti fakaafe ke fekau kiate ia.
gloss.hyperfocus.text: 🎯 Ko ha poloseki pē ʻe taha mo hoʻo ngaahi pōpoaki ʻoku hā, ke ʻoua naʻa ai ha toe meʻa ʻe tohoakiʻi koe. ʻOku hokohoko atu pē e ngāue ʻa e ngaahi timi.
gloss.qa.text: Ko e nounou ia ʻo e quality assurance: ko e meʻa kotoa ʻoku fai ke fakapapauʻi ʻoku tonu e ngāue kimuʻa pea hū ki he laine. ʻI he AI-gile ʻoku ʻuhinga ia ki he ngaahi sivi ʻauto: ʻi he taimi ʻoku kulokula ai e QA, kuo tō ha meʻa, pea ʻe ʻikai ke lava ʻo hū ki he laine kae ʻoua ke fakalelei.
gloss.release.text: Ko ha kulupu ngāue kuo ʻosi kuo fakahingoa ʻoku hū fakataha ki he laine, mo ha ngaahi fakamatala nounou ki he meʻa naʻe liliu. ʻOku tohi ʻe he 🚀 Ngaahi tukuange ʻa e ngaahi fakamatala mei he ngaahi kaati kuo ʻosi.
gloss.rollback.text: Ko hono foki ki he veesini fakamuimui naʻe ngāue ʻi he taimi ʻoku fakatupu palopalema ai ha veesini foʻou. ʻI he AI-gile, ko e Roll back ʻoku ne tānaki e ngaahi sitepu toʻo kuo tohi ʻi he liliu taki taha ki ha lisi sivi ʻe taha.
gloss.live.text: Ko e paaki moʻoni ʻoku ngāueʻaki ʻe he kakai, ʻo kehe mei ha kopi ke ʻahiʻahi ai ha ngaahi meʻa. ʻOku ui foki ia ʻe he kau fakatupulaki ko e production.
gloss.change.text: Ko ha liliu kuo palani ki ha meʻa ʻoku falala ki ai ʻa e kakai, ʻoku tohi ʻuluaki: ko e hā, ko e hā hono ʻuhinga, ko e fakatuʻutāmaki, ʻafē, pea mo e founga ke toe fakafoki ai. Kamata ʻaki ʻa e 🔀 Kole ha liliu.
gloss.risk.text: Ko ha meʻa ʻe ala hala, kuo fakamaaka ʻo fakatatau ki hono ngalingali mo e kovi ʻo ka hoko. ʻOku tauhi ʻe he ⚠️ Ngaahi fakatuʻutāmaki ʻi ha lisi pē ʻe taha, ko e maaka māʻolunga taha ʻi muʻa, taki taha mo ha ʻaho ke toe vakai ai.
gloss.chgwin.text: Ko e ngaahi taimi ʻoku ngofua ai ke hū ʻa e ngaahi liliu ki he laine, hangē ko ha efiafi Tūsite longolongo. ʻI tuʻa ʻi ha taimi liliu ʻe ʻikai lava ke fakaʻosi ha kaati liliu, tukukehe kapau ko ha meʻa fakavavevave.
gloss.gonogo.text: Ko ha sivi fakaʻosi pē kimuʻa pea hū ha liliu ki he laine: ko e tokotaha taki taha ʻoku totonu ke ne fakangofua ʻoku ne pehē ʻAlu pe ʻIkai ʻalu. ʻOku hoko atu pē ʻo ka nau pehē kotoa ʻAlu.
gloss.approval.text: Tatali ki ha ʻio kimuʻa pea kamata ʻa e ngāue. Ko ha kaati ʻoku fokotuʻu ʻe ha kaumeʻa, pe ko ha liliu, ʻoku tatali ʻi he ✅ Ngaahi fakangofua kae ʻoua ke ke fakangofua pe fakafisi.
gloss.quiettime.text: Ko ha vahaʻa taimi, hangē ko e lolotonga ha fakamafola moʻui, ha demo pe ko e pō, ʻoku ʻikai hū ai ha meʻa ki he laine. ʻOku hokohoko atu e ngāue mo e sivi ʻa e ngaahi timi, ka ʻoku tatali e hū ki he laine kae ʻoua ke ʻosi. ʻI he ngaahi feituʻu kehe ʻoku ui ia ko e change freeze.
gloss.service.text: Ko ha meʻa naʻa ke langa ʻoku falala ki ai ʻa e kakai, hangē ko ha uepisaiti pe ha ʻapi, ʻoku tokangaʻi ke hoko atu ʻene ngāue. Fakamaʻaka ʻa e “Ko e poloseki ni ko ha sēvesi” pea fakahā ʻa e meʻa ʻoku ne foaki, ko hai ʻoku ngāueʻaki ia, mo hai ʻoku tokanga.
gloss.uptime.text: Ko ha sivi ʻoku fai ʻe ia pē, ʻi he miniti siʻi kotoa pē, pe ʻoku kei tali mai hoʻo sēvesi. Kapau ʻe tō ʻo liunga lahi hokohoko, ʻe fakaava ʻe he AI-gile ha kaati meʻa fakatuʻupakē ʻiate ia pē.
gloss.statuspage.text: Ko ha peesi fakakātoa ʻoku ne fakahā pe ʻoku ngāue ha sēvesi (lanu mata, lanu moli pe kulokula) mo e ongoongo fakamuimui taha, koeʻuhi ke lava ʻe he kakai ʻoku nau ngāueʻaki ʻo vakai kae ʻikai fehuʻi.
gloss.incident.text: Ko ha meʻa kuo maumau pe ʻikai ngāue lelei maʻá e kakai ʻoku nau ngāueʻaki ia he taimi ni, hangē ko e tuʻu pe tuai fau ʻo e uepisaiti. ʻOku puna ki muʻa ʻi he laine ha kaati 🔥 meʻa fakatuʻupakē: ko hono toe fakangāueʻi ʻoku ʻuluaki.
gloss.major.text: Ko ha meʻa fakatuʻupakē lahi: tokolahi ʻoku uesia, pe ʻoku ʻi he fakatuʻutāmaki ʻa e paʻanga pe ngaahi fakamatala. ʻOku tuku ʻe ha meʻa lomiʻi pē ʻe taha ʻa e ngaahi timi kotoa ki ai (ngāue fakataha), ʻoku ueʻi ʻa e tokotaha ʻoku tokanga, pea kole ha ongoongo tuʻunga ʻi he miniti ʻe 30 kotoa pē.
gloss.oncall.text: Ko e hoko ko e tokotaha ʻoku tali ʻi he taimi ʻoku maumau ai ha meʻa, naʻa mo e pō. ʻOku ʻi ai ʻi he sēvesi taki taha ha mēmipa timi ʻoku tokanga ʻoku ʻuluaki ueʻi ki hono ngaahi meʻa fakatuʻupakē.
gloss.replyby.text: Ko e fuoloa ʻe lava ke tatali ai ha kaati ki ha ʻuluaki tali, hangē ko e houa ʻe taha ki ha meʻa fakatuʻupakē. Hili iá ʻoku maʻu ʻe ia ha uasi kulokula, koeʻuhi ke ʻoua naʻa ngalo fakalongolongo ha meʻa. ʻOku ui foki ko e taumuʻa tali.
gloss.postmortem.also: postmortem,toe vakai hili ha meʻa fakatuʻupakē
gloss.postmortem.text: Ko ha toe vakai nounou hili ha meʻa fakatuʻupakē: ko e hā naʻe hoko, ko e hā naʻe tokoni, pea ko e hā ke liliu, ʻo ʻikai tukuakiʻi ha taha. ʻE ʻikai lava ke tāpuni ha meʻa fakatuʻupakē ʻo ʻikai ha taha.
gloss.problem.text: Ko e tupuʻanga fufū ʻi mui ʻi ha meʻa fakatuʻupakē ʻe taha pe lahi ange. ʻOku tānaki fakataha ʻe ha kaati 🧩 palopalema ʻa e ngaahi meʻa fakatuʻupakē ʻoku toe foki mai, koeʻuhi ke ʻilo ʻa e tupuʻanga pea fakatonutonu taʻengata.
gloss.rootcause.text: Ko e ʻuhinga moʻoni naʻe maumau ai ha meʻa, ʻikai ko e meʻa pē naʻa ke sio ki ai ʻoku hala. Fakatonutonu ʻa e tupuʻanga pea ʻe tuku ʻa e toe foki mai ʻa e meʻa fakatuʻupakē.
gloss.workaround.text: Ko ha founga ke tauhi ke ngāue ʻa e ngaahi meʻa kae ʻoua ke mateuteu ʻa e fakatonutonu moʻoni, hangē ko hono toe kamata ha meʻa ʻi he taimi ʻoku piki ai. ʻOku tohi ia ʻi he kaati palopalema koeʻuhi ke ʻoua naʻa toe fiemaʻu ke kumi ʻe ha taha.
gloss.knownerror.text: Ko ha palopalema ʻoku mahino hono tupuʻanga ka ʻoku teʻeki fakalelei, ʻoku faʻa ʻi ai ha founga fakataimi kuo tohi. Ko e 🧩 Ngaahi hala ʻoku ʻiloa ʻoku ne lisi kinautolu, ke ngāueʻaki ʻe he tokotaha kotoa e founga fakataimi ʻo ʻikai toe keli.
gloss.runbook.text: Ko ha ngaahi fakahinohino sitepu ki he sitepu ke fakatonutonu ha faʻahinga palopalema ʻoku ʻiloa, koeʻuhi ke fai tatau mo vave ʻi he taimi kotoa pē. Hili ha meʻa fakatuʻupakē lahi ʻe lava ʻe he timi ʻo fokotuʻu atu ha taha ke ke OK.
gloss.backup.text: Ko ha kopi kuo tauhi ʻo hoʻo ngaahi fakamatala mei muʻa, ke falala ki ai ʻo kapau ʻe mole pe maumau ha meʻa. ʻOku ngaohi ʻe he AI-gile ha kopi maluʻi ʻo hoʻo ngaahi papa ʻi he ʻaho kotoa pē.
gloss.restore.text: Toe fakafoki mai ʻa e ngaahi fakamatala mei ha kopi maluʻi. ʻOku mahuʻinga moʻoni pē ha kopi maluʻi ʻo ka ke ʻilo ʻe lava ke toe fakafoki, ko ia ʻoku ʻaonga ke ʻahiʻahi ʻi he taimi ʻe niʻihi.
gloss.dod.word: Ko e fakamatala ʻo e ʻOsi
gloss.dod.text: Ko e lisi sivi nounou ʻa e timi ki he ʻuhinga ʻo e “ʻosi”, hangē ko e kuo sivi mo fakamatalaʻi, kimuʻa pea ʻoatu ha kaati kiate koe. Ko hono māhanga, ko e fakamatala ʻo e Mateuteu, ʻoku ne fakahā ʻa e taimi ʻoku mahino feʻunga ai ha kaati ke kamata.
gloss.testpile.text: Ko e ngaahi kaati kuo ʻosi ʻoku tatali ke ke ʻahiʻahi, taha ki he taha. Tali ha taha pe fakafoki mo ha fakamatala, pea hoko mai ʻa e hoko.
gloss.retro.text: Ko ha toe vakai angamaheni ki he founga ʻoku ngāue ai e timi, ke loto taha ki ha meʻa ʻe taha pe ua ke fai lelei ange ʻi he hoko. Ko e nounou ia ʻo e retrospective. ʻI he AI-gile ʻoku fokotuʻu ʻe ha retro ha liliu ki he founga ngāue ʻa e timi, pea ʻokú ke pehē ʻAlu pe ʻIkai ʻi he taimi ni.
gloss.peerreview.text: Ko ha ongo mata hono ua: ʻoku sivi ʻe ha taha kehe ʻo e tokotaha tohi ʻa e ngāue kimuʻa pea aʻu kiate koe, ke siʻi ange e ngaahi hala ʻoku hao atu. ʻI he AI-gile ʻoku sivi ʻe ha AI kehe e kaati taki taha.
gloss.swarm.text: Nima kotoa ki he ngāue: ʻoku tuku ʻe he kakai tokolahi e ngāue kehe ke fakalelei fakataha ha meʻa fakavavevave ʻe taha kae ʻoua ke lelei. ʻI he AI-gile ʻoku tokoni e timi kotoa ki ha poloseki ʻe taha, pea ʻoku tatali e ngaahi poloseki kehe he lolotonga.
gloss.scrummaster.text: ʻI he Scrum, ko e tokotaha ʻoku ne tokoni ki he timi ke ngāue lelei: ʻoku ne toʻo e ngaahi meʻa ʻoku taʻofi kinautolu, tauhi e ngaahi fakataha ʻi he hala, pea akoʻi e ngaahi angamaheni lelei, taʻe pule ki ha taha. ʻI he AI-gile ʻoku sio e Taki Scrum Master ki he ngaahi kaati kuo tuʻu, ueʻi e ngaahi timi pea fakamanatu atu kiate koe e meʻa ʻoku tatali, ʻi he poloseki kotoa.
gloss.scrummaster.text.noai: ʻI he Scrum, ko e tokotaha ʻoku ne tokoni ki he timi ke ngāue lelei: ʻoku ne toʻo e ngaahi meʻa ʻoku taʻofi kinautolu, tauhi e ngaahi fakataha ʻi he hala, pea akoʻi e ngaahi angamaheni lelei, taʻe pule ki ha taha. Taʻe ha AI, ko e veesini ʻa e AI-gile ʻoku sio ki he ngaahi kaati kuo tuʻu pea ngāue ʻaki ha ngaahi fekau tuʻumaʻu, hangē ko hono fokotuʻutuʻu e Ke fai.
gloss.discovery.text: Ko e vahaʻa kamata ke ʻilo ai pe ko e palopalema fē ʻoku mahuʻinga ke fakalelei mo ko hai ia, kimuʻa pea langa ha meʻa.
gloss.problemstmt.also: ngaahi fakamatala ʻo e palopalema,problem statement,problem statements
gloss.problemstmt.text: Ko e sētesi ʻe taha pe ua ʻoku ne pehē ko hai ʻoku ʻi ai hano palopalema, ko e hā ia mo e ʻuhinga ʻoku mahuʻinga ai, ke tuhu kotoa pē ki he meʻa tatau.
gloss.user.text: Ko ha tokotaha ʻoku ngāueʻaki e meʻa ʻokú ke langa. Ko e meʻa ʻoku nau fiemaʻu ko e ʻuhinga ia ʻo e ngāue.
gloss.stakeholder.text: Ko ha taha pē ʻoku tokanga ki he ola ʻo e ngāue pe ʻoku uesia ai, hangē ko e kakai ʻoku nau totongi, ngāueʻaki pe tokoni ki ai.
gloss.persona.text: Ko ha tokotaha fakatātā ka ʻoku hangē ha tokotaha moʻoni, ʻoku fakafofonga ki ha faʻahinga ʻe taha ʻo e kau ngāueʻaki, ke lava ʻe he timi ʻo fehuʻi “ʻe ongoʻi faingofua nai ʻe Sam ʻeni?”
gloss.userresearch.text: Ko hono talanoa mo sio ki he kakai moʻoni ke ʻilo e meʻa ʻoku nau fiemaʻu, ʻo ʻikai ko hono fakafuofua pē.
gloss.journey.also: user journey,user journeys,customer journey,fononga ʻo e tokotaha ngāueʻaki
gloss.journey.text: Ko e ngaahi sitepu ʻoku fai ʻe ha tokotaha ke fakahoko ha meʻa, mei he ʻuluaki fanongo ki ai ʻo aʻu ki hono fakaʻosi, tatau ai pē mo ʻi tuʻa ʻi hoʻo koloa. Ko hono tā ia ʻoku ne fakahā e feituʻu ʻoku faingataʻa ai kiate kinautolu.
gloss.painpoint.text: Ko ha meʻa ʻoku fakamāfasia pe fakatuai e kakai he taimi ni. Ko e ngaahi koloa lelei ʻoku nau toʻo atu e ngaahi meʻa fakahouhau.
gloss.assumption.text: Ko ha meʻa ʻokú ke tui ki ai ka ʻoku teʻeki ke ke sivi. Ko hono tohi ʻo e ngaahi fakakaukau taʻe sivi ʻoku ne fakahā e meʻa ke sivi ʻuluaki.
gloss.hypothesis.text: Ko ha fakafuofua lelei taha ʻokú ke palani ke sivi, mo e meʻa ʻokú ke ʻamanaki ʻe hoko, hangē ko e “ʻe hū mai e kakai kapau ʻoku taʻetotongi e mahina ʻuluaki”.
gloss.experiment.text: Ko ha sivi siʻisiʻi kuo palani ke ʻilo pe ʻoku ngāue ha fakakaukau, kimuʻa pea tuku ha meʻa lahi ki ai.
gloss.poc.text: Ko ha feinga vave mo fakalalahi ke sio pe ʻe lava nai ʻo ngāue ha fakakaukau. ʻOku faʻa liʻaki ia hili hono maʻu e tali.
gloss.prototype.text: Ko ha sīpinga ʻuluaki ʻo e koloa, ʻoku faʻa hoko ko ha ngaahi tā ʻoku lava ke lomi, ke sivi ʻa e fakakaukau ki he kakai kimuʻa pea langa totonu.
gloss.wireframe.text: Ko ha tā faingofua ʻo ha sikilini ʻoku fakahā ai e feituʻu ʻe tuku ai e ngaahi meʻa, taʻe ha lanu pe ngaahi meʻa moʻoni.
gloss.mockup.text: Ko ha tā fakaikiiki ʻo e anga ʻo ha sikilini, mo e ngaahi lanu mo e tohi moʻoni, ka ʻoku teʻeki ngāue ha meʻa.
gloss.bizcase.text: Ko e ngaahi ʻuhinga ke fai ai ha poloseki: ko e hā hono fakamole, ko e hā ʻoku ne ʻomi pe fakahaofi, mo e ngaahi fakatuʻutāmaki.
gloss.feasibility.text: Pe ʻe lava moʻoni ke langa mo tauhi ha meʻa ʻaki e taimi, paʻanga mo e poto ʻokú ke maʻu.
gloss.outcome.text: Ko e liliu ʻokú ke loto ki ai maʻá e kakai, hangē ko e siʻi ange ʻa e kakai ʻoku ʻikai haʻu ki heʻenau taimi kuo alea. ʻOku mahuʻinga ange ia ʻi he lahi ʻo e meʻa ʻokú ke langa.
gloss.output.text: Ko ha meʻa ʻoku ngaohi ʻe he timi, hangē ko ha sikilini foʻou pe ha lipooti. Ko hono ngaohi ʻoku ʻikai ke tuku pau ai ʻoku ne tokoni ki ha taha.
gloss.successmetric.text: Ko ha fika ʻoku ne fakahā pe naʻe aʻusia ʻe he ngāue hono taumuʻa, hangē ko e tokolahi ange ʻo e kakai ʻoku nau fakaʻosi ʻenau ʻota.
gloss.kpi.text: Ko ha fika mahuʻinga ʻokú ke sio ki ai ke ʻilo pe ʻoku lelei e ngaahi meʻa, hangē ko e kau hū foʻou he uike.
gloss.okr.text: Ko ha founga ke fokotuʻu ai e ngaahi taumuʻa: ko e objective ʻoku ne pehē ko e hā ʻokú ke loto ki ai, pea ko ha ngaahi key result siʻi ko e ngaahi fika ia ʻoku fakahā ʻokú ke aʻu ki ai.
gloss.product.text: Ko e meʻa ʻoku langa mo tauhi maʻá e kau ngāueʻaki, hangē ko ha app, ha uepisaiti pe ha meʻangāue.
gloss.vision.text: Ko ha fakamatala nounou ki he tokotaha ʻoku tokoni ki ai e koloa mo e feituʻu ʻoku ʻalu ki ai ʻi he kahaʻu lōloa.
gloss.po.also: PO,product owner,product owners,tokotaha ʻoʻona e koloa
gloss.po.text: Ko e tokotaha ʻoku ne fili e meʻa ke langa mo e hokohoko, ke ngāue maʻu pē e timi ki he meʻa mahuʻinga taha. ʻI he AI-gile ko koe ia.
gloss.pm.text: Ko e tokotaha ʻoku ne tokangaʻi e hala ʻo e koloa: ko e palopalema fē ʻoku ne fakalelei, maʻa hai pea ko e hā hono ʻuhinga. Ko e PM ʻe lava foki ke ʻuhinga ki he pule poloseki, ko ia vakaiʻi pe ko e fē ia.
gloss.projmgr.text: Ko e tokotaha ʻoku ne tauhi ke hoko ha poloseki ʻi he taimi mo e paʻanga kuo fokotuʻu, ʻo muimui pe ko hai ʻoku ne fai e hā pea ki he ʻaho fē.
gloss.roadmap.text: Ko ha palani fakafuofua ʻo e meʻa ʻe hoko mai ʻi he ngaahi mahina ka hoko mai, ʻo hokohoko. ʻOku ne fakahā e hala, ʻikai ko e ngaahi ʻaho tonu, pea ʻoku liliu ʻi hoʻo ako ha meʻa foʻou.
gloss.milestone.text: Ko ha taimi ʻi ha poloseki ʻoku mahuʻinga ke fakaʻilonga, hangē ko e “kuo hū e veesini ʻuluaki” pe “kau ngāueʻaki ʻe 100”.
gloss.mvp.text: Ko e veesini siʻi taha ʻo ha koloa ʻoku kei ʻaonga ki he kakai moʻoni, ke lava ʻo ako meia kinautolu ʻi he kamata.
gloss.requirement.text: Ko ha meʻa ʻoku totonu ke fakahoko pe hoko ʻe he koloa kuo ʻosi.
gloss.scope.text: Ko e meʻa ʻoku kau ʻi he ngāue pea, ʻoku mahuʻinga tatau, ko e meʻa ʻoku ʻikai kau ai.
gloss.scopecreep.text: Ko e taimi ʻoku tānaki māmālie atu ai e ngaahi meʻa lahi ange ki he ngāue, taʻe loto taha ha taha ki he taimi pe fakamole fakalahi, ko ia ʻoku ʻikai ʻosi lelei ia ʻo taʻengata.
gloss.feature.text: Ko ha meʻa ʻe taha ʻoku lava ʻe he koloa ʻo fai maʻá e kakai, hangē ko e “toe fokotuʻu hoʻo lea fakaʻilonga”.
gloss.epic.text: Ko ha konga ngāue lahi, lahi fau ke fai ʻi he taimi ʻe taha, ko ia ʻoku vaheʻi ia ki he ngaahi kaati siʻi ange.
gloss.story.also: user stories,talanoa ʻo e tokotaha ngāueʻaki
gloss.story.text: Ko ha konga ngāue siʻi kuo tohi mei he tafaʻaki ʻo e tokotaha ngāueʻaki: “ʻI heʻeku hoko ko ha tokotaha fakatau, ʻoku ou loto ke u tauhi hoku kato, ke u lava ʻo fakaʻosi ia ʻamui.” ʻOku ne kamata ha talanoa ki he meʻa ke langa.
gloss.ac.text: Ko e ngaahi sivi ʻoku totonu ke lava ai ha kaati ke lau ʻoku ʻosi, kuo loto taha ki ai kimuʻa pea kamata e ngāue, hangē ko e “ʻoku kei ai e kato hili ʻeku hū ki tuʻa pea toe hū mai”.
gloss.task.text: Ko ha ngāue ʻe taha ke fai, ʻoku faʻa hoko ko ha sitepu siʻi ʻo ha user story lahi ange.
gloss.ticket.text: Ko ha toe hingoa ia ki he kaati: ko ha konga ngāue pe kole ʻe taha, ʻoku muimui ki ai mei he kamata ki he ʻosi.
gloss.priority.text: Ko e mahuʻinga pe fakavavevave ʻo ha meʻa ʻi he fehoanaki mo e ngaahi meʻa kehe kotoa, ke fai ʻuluaki e ngāue mahuʻinga taha.
gloss.prioritise.text: Ko hono tuku e ngāue ʻi he hokohoko ʻo e mahuʻinga. Ko ha founga angamaheni ko e MoSCoW: Must have (ʻoku fiemaʻu), Should have (totonu ke ʻi ai), Could have (lava ke ʻi ai), Won’t have this time (ʻikai ʻi he taimi ni).
gloss.estimate.text: Ko ha fakafuofua lelei taha ki he lahi pe lōloa ʻo ha konga ngāue. Ko ha fakafuofua ia, ʻikai ko ha talaʻofa.
gloss.storypoints.text: Ko ha founga ke fakafuofua ai e lahi ʻo e ngāue ʻaki hono fakahoa e ngaahi kaati ki he taha mo e taha (“ko e lahi tuʻo ua ʻo e taha ko ia”), ʻo ʻikai ʻaki e ngaahi houa. ʻOku ʻikai ke ngāueʻaki ke fakahoa ʻaki e ngaahi timi.
gloss.tshirt.text: Ko hono fakafuofua e lahi ʻo e ngāue ʻaki ha S, M, L pe XL. Vave pea lelei feʻunga ki he palani ʻuluaki.
gloss.poker.text: Ko ha vaʻinga ki he fakafuofua: ʻoku fakahā fakataha ʻe he tokotaha kotoa ha kaati ʻoku hā ai ha lahi, pea ʻoku fakamatala ʻe he ongo tokotaha naʻá na fili ʻa e lahi taha mo e siʻi taha hona ʻuhinga.
gloss.dependency.text: Ko e taimi ʻoku ʻikai lava ai ke kamata pe fakaʻosi ha konga ngāue kae ʻoua ke fai ha taha kehe.
gloss.blocker.text: Ko ha meʻa pē ʻoku taʻofi e ngāue mei he ʻalu ki muʻa he taimi ni, hangē ko ha tali ʻoku ʻikai ke maʻu pe ha meʻangāue kuo maumau.
gloss.deadline.text: Ko e ʻaho ʻoku totonu ke fakaʻosi ai ha meʻa.
gloss.deliverable.text: Ko ha meʻa moʻoni ʻoku ngaohi mo ʻoatu ʻe he ngāue, hangē ko ha peesi ʻoku ngāue pe ha lipooti.
gloss.forecast.text: Ko ha tomuʻa tala ki he meʻa ʻoku ngalingali ʻe hoko, hangē ko e taimi ʻe ʻosi ai e ngāue, ʻo makatuʻunga ʻi he meʻa ʻokú ke ʻilo he taimi ni.
gloss.metric.text: Ko ha meʻa pē ʻokú ke fua mo muimui ki ai ʻi he fakalaka ʻo e taimi, hangē ko e kau sio ki he peesi pe ko e fuoloa ʻo ha fakalelei.
gloss.feedback.text: Ko e meʻa ʻoku tala atu ʻe he kakai ki hoʻo ngāue, lelei mo kovi. Ko hono maʻu vave mo faʻa ko e mafu ia ʻo e Agile.
gloss.agile.also: Agile development,agile ways of working,founga ngāue Agile
gloss.agile.text: Ko ha founga ngāue ʻi he ngaahi sitepu siʻi: langa siʻisiʻi, faʻa fakahā ʻa e ngaahi ola moʻoni, ako mei he meʻa ʻoku lea ʻaki ʻe he kakai pea liliu e palani ʻi he ʻalu atu, ʻo ʻikai ko hono palani kotoa ʻi he kamata.
gloss.manifesto.text: Ko ha fakamatala nounou naʻe tohi ʻi he 2001 ʻe he kau ngaohi polokalama. ʻOku ne tuku e kakai, ngaahi ola ʻoku ngāue, ngāue vāofi mo e kau kasitomā pea tali ha liliu, ʻi muʻa ʻi he ngaahi palani mamafa mo e ngaahi tohi lahi.
gloss.waterfall.text: Ko e founga ngāue motuʻa: palani e meʻa kotoa, pea langa kotoa ia, pea sivi kotoa ia, ko e sitepu taki taha hili ʻa e taha. Ko e ngaahi liliu ʻi he kimui ʻoku faingataʻa mo mamafa e fakamole.
gloss.iteration.text: Ko ha takai ʻe taha ʻo e langa ha meʻa, sivi ia mo fakalelei ia. Ko e ngāue Agile ko ha hokohoko ʻo e ngaahi takai pehē, pea ko e sprint ko ha faʻahinga ʻe taha.
gloss.increment.text: Ko ha konga foʻou ʻoku ngāue ʻoku tānaki ki he koloa ʻi ha sprint pe takai ngāue, pea ʻoku fehoanaki mo e meʻa naʻe ʻosi ʻi ai.
gloss.scrum.text: Ko ha founga ngāue Agile ʻoku ʻiloa lahi: ko ha timi siʻi ʻoku ngāue ʻi he ngaahi sprint nounou ki ha taumuʻa, mo e ngaahi fatongia kuo fokotuʻu pea mo ha ngaahi fakataha angamaheni siʻi ke palani, vakaiʻi mo fakalelei.
gloss.scrumteam.text: Ko e kulupu siʻi ʻoku fai e ngāue ʻi he Scrum: ko ha product owner, ko ha Scrum Master mo e kau langa.
gloss.ceremonies.text: Ko e ngaahi fakataha angamaheni ʻi he Scrum: ko e palani sprint, ko e daily scrum, ko e sprint review mo e retro. ʻOku ui ia ʻe he tokolahi ko e ceremonies.
gloss.sprintplan.text: Ko e fakataha ʻi he kamata ʻo ha sprint ʻoku loto taha ai e timi ki he ʻuhinga ʻoku mahuʻinga ai e sprint, ko e ngaahi kaati fē ke fai mo e founga ke kamata ai.
gloss.sprintgoal.text: Ko ha sētesi ʻe taha ʻoku pehē ai ko e hā e ʻuhinga ʻo ha sprint. Ko e ngaahi ngāue siʻi ʻoku lava ke liliu ʻi he ʻalu atu, ʻo kapau ʻe aʻusia pē ʻa e taumuʻa.
gloss.sprintbacklog.text: Ko e ngaahi kaati kuo fili ki he sprint lolotonga, mo e palani ʻa e timi ke fai ia.
gloss.productbacklog.text: Ko e lisi kakato kuo hokohoko ʻo e meʻa kotoa ʻe ala langa maʻá e koloa, mo e mahuʻinga taha ʻi ʻolunga. ʻOku hokohoko atu hono liliu ʻi hoʻo ako ha meʻa foʻou.
gloss.productgoal.text: Ko e ola lahi ange ʻoku ngāue ki ai e koloa, ʻoku tokoni ki he timi ke fili e meʻa ke fai hoko.
gloss.refinement.text: Ko hono vakaiʻi maʻu pē ʻo e backlog ke fakamaʻa, vaheʻi, hokohokoʻi mo tānaki ha fakaikiiki ki he ngaahi kaati, ke mateuteu ke ʻave. ʻOku ui foki ko e backlog grooming.
gloss.sprintreview.text: Ko ha fakataha ʻi he ngataʻanga ʻo ha sprint ʻoku fakahā ai ʻe he timi e meʻa kuo ʻosi pea fanongo ki he fakakaukau ʻa e kakai, ke fili e meʻa ʻe hoko atu.
gloss.demo.text: Ko hono fakahā e ngāue kuo ʻosi ʻoku ngāue moʻoni, ʻi he taimi tonu, ki he kakai naʻa nau kole ia.
gloss.timebox.text: Ko ha lahi taimi kuo fokotuʻu ki ha meʻa. Ka ʻosi e taimi ʻokú ke taʻofi, neongo ʻoku teʻeki ʻosi e meʻa kotoa.
gloss.velocity.text: Ko e lahi ʻo e ngāue ʻoku faʻa fakaʻosi ʻe ha timi ʻi ha sprint, ʻoku ngāueʻaki ke palani e lahi ke toʻo ʻi he taimi hoko. ʻIkai ko ha sikoa ia ki he mālohi ʻo e ngāue ʻa e kakai.
gloss.capacity.text: Ko e lahi ʻo e ngāue ʻe lava ʻe he timi ʻo ʻave ʻi ha vahaʻa taimi, hili ʻa e ngaahi mālōlō mo e ngaahi ngāue kehe.
gloss.burndown.text: Ko ha sati ʻo e ngāue ʻoku toe ʻi ha sprint ʻoku ʻalu hifo ʻaho ʻe ʻaho. Kapau ʻoku tuʻu tatau e laine, ʻoku ʻi ai ha meʻa kuo tuʻu.
gloss.burnup.text: Ko ha sati ʻo e ngāue kuo ʻosi ʻoku ʻalu hake ʻi he taimi, ʻo fakahoa mo e kātoa kuo palani, ke ke sio ki he taimi te ke aʻu ai.
gloss.kanbanboard.text: Ko e laupapa pē ia: ko ha kolomu ki he sitepu taki taha ʻo e ngāue, mo e ngaahi kaati ʻoku ʻalu fakalaka ai.
gloss.pullsys.text: Ko ha founga ngāue ʻoku kamata ai e ngāue foʻou ʻi he taimi pē ʻoku ʻi ai ha taha ʻoku ʻi ai hono taimi ke fai ia, ʻo ʻikai ko hono fokotuʻu ki ha taha kuo fonu hono nima.
gloss.flow.also: flow of work,tafe ʻo e ngāue
gloss.flow.text: Ko e anga ʻo e ʻalu lelei ʻa e ngāue ʻi he laupapa. Ko e tafe lelei ʻoku ʻuhinga ʻoku hokohoko atu e ʻalu ʻa e ngaahi kaati ʻo ʻikai ke nau tānaki fakaʻutuʻutu.
gloss.leadtime.text: Ko e fuoloa mei he taimi ʻoku kole ai ha taha ki ha meʻa ʻo aʻu ki hono fakaʻosi.
gloss.cycletime.text: Ko e fuoloa ʻoku fiemaʻu ʻe ha kaati mei he taimi ʻoku kamata moʻoni ai e ngāue ki ai ʻo aʻu ki hono ʻosi.
gloss.throughput.text: Ko e lahi ʻo e ngaahi kaati ʻoku ʻosi he uike ʻe taha, pe ʻi ha vahaʻa taimi pē kuo fokotuʻu.
gloss.bottleneck.text: Ko e sitepu ʻe taha ʻoku tānaki ai e ngāue pea fakatuai e meʻa kotoa ʻi mui, hangē ko e kia lausiʻi ʻo ha hina.
gloss.swimlane.text: Ko ha laine ʻi he laupapa ʻoku fakatahaʻi ai e ngaahi kaati ʻo e faʻahinga tatau, hangē ko e ngāue fakavavevave pe ko e ngaahi kaati ʻa ha timi ʻe taha.
gloss.lean.text: Ko ha founga ngāue ʻoku ne toʻo atu e moumou (ha meʻa pē ʻoku ʻikai tokoni ki he kasitomā) pea tauhi e tafe ʻo e ngāue.
gloss.waste.text: ʻI he Lean, ko ha meʻa pē ʻoku fakamoleki ai e mālohi ka ʻikai tokoni ki he kasitomā, hangē ko e tatali, toe fai, pe langa ha ngaahi meʻa ʻoku ʻikai ngāueʻaki ʻe ha taha.
gloss.kaizen.text: Ko hono lelei ange ʻi he taimi kotoa ʻaki ha ngaahi liliu siʻi mo angamaheni, pea sivi pe naʻe tokoni. Ko e ngaahi retro ko ha founga ʻe taha. ʻOku ui foki ko e kaizen.
gloss.selforg.text: Ko ha timi ʻoku ne fili ʻiate ia e founga ke fai ai e ngāue, ʻo ʻikai ko hono tala sitepu ʻe sitepu.
gloss.crossfunc.text: Ko ha timi ʻoku ʻi ai e poto kotoa ʻoku fiemaʻu ke fakaʻosi ʻe ia pē e ngāue, hangē ko e tisaini, langa mo e sivi.
gloss.spike.text: Ko ha fekumi nounou mo fokotuʻu taimi ke tali ha fehuʻi kimuʻa pea tukupā ki he ngāue moʻoni.
gloss.rework.text: Ko hono toe fai e ngāue koeʻuhi naʻe ʻikai tonu ʻi he ʻuluaki.
gloss.safe.text: Ko e ngaahi founga ke ngāueʻaki ai e Agile ʻi ha ngaahi timi tokolahi ʻi ha pisinisi pe potungāue lahi. Ko e SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) ko ha sīpinga ʻe taha ʻoku ʻiloa lelei.
gloss.code.text: Ko e ngaahi fekau kuo tohi ʻoku ne tala ki ha komipiuta e meʻa ke fai. ʻOku ui foki ko e source code.
gloss.proglang.text: Ko ha lea ki hono tohi ʻo e koti, hangē ko e JavaScript, Python pe Java. Ko e ngaahi lea kehekehe ʻoku feʻunga mo e ngaahi ngāue kehekehe.
gloss.developer.text: Ko ha tokotaha ʻoku tohi mo liliu e koti. ʻOku ui foki ko e programmer pe software engineer.
gloss.software.text: Ko e ngaahi polokalama ʻoku lele ʻi he ngaahi komipiuta mo e telefoni, ʻo ʻikai ko e ngaahi mīsini ʻanautolu (ko e hardware).
gloss.app.text: Ko e nounou ia ʻo e application: ko ha polokalama ʻoku ngāueʻaki ʻe he kakai ke fakahoko ha meʻa, ʻi ha telefoni, ha komipiuta pe ʻi ha polauzā uepi.
gloss.webapp.text: Ko ha app ʻoku lele ʻi ha polauzā uepi, ko ia ʻoku ʻikai fiemaʻu ha meʻa ke fokotuʻu.
gloss.frontend.text: Ko e konga ʻo ha app ʻokú ke sio ki ai mo lomi: ko e ngaahi sikilini, ngaahi puha lomi mo e ngaahi lea, ʻo faʻa ʻi hoʻo polauzā.
gloss.backend.text: Ko e konga ʻo ha app ʻoku ʻi mui ʻoku ne tauhi e fakamatala pea fai e ngāue ʻi he taimi ʻokú ke lomi ai ha meʻa, hangē ko hono sivi hoʻo lea fakaʻilonga.
gloss.fullstack.text: Ko e ngāue ki he front end mo e back end fakatouʻosi.
gloss.ui.text: Ko e meʻa ʻoku sio ki ai mo ngāueʻaki ʻe ha tokotaha ʻi he sikilini: ko e fokotuʻu, ngaahi puha lomi, ngaahi lisi mo e ngaahi lea.
gloss.ux.text: Ko e anga ʻo e ongo ʻo hono ngāueʻaki ha meʻa: faingofua, mahino mo fakafiefia, pe fakapuputuʻu mo tuai.
gloss.accessibility.text: Ko hono ngaohi e ngaahi meʻa ke lava ʻo ngāueʻaki ʻe he tokotaha kotoa, kau ai e kakai ʻoku ʻikai sio lelei, ʻikai lava ke ngāueʻaki ha māusi pe ngāueʻaki ha screen reader.
gloss.responsive.text: Ko hono ngaohi e ngaahi peesi ke feʻunga mo ngāue lelei ʻi he lahi pē ʻo e sikilini, mei ha telefoni ki ha sikilini lahi.
gloss.designsys.text: Ko ha kato meʻangāue vahevahe ʻo e ngaahi lanu, faʻahinga mataʻitohi, ngaahi puha lomi mo e ngaahi lao, ke ʻasi tatau mo ngāue tatau e sikilini kotoa.
gloss.architecture.text: Ko e fōtunga fakalūkufua ʻo ha sisitemi: ko e ngaahi konga tefito ko e hā mo e anga ʻo ʻenau talanoa ki he taha mo e taha.
gloss.database.text: Ko ha tauhi fakalelei ʻo e fakamatala, hangē ko ha spreadsheet mālohi fau ʻoku lava ʻe he app ʻo lau mo liliu.
gloss.schema.text: Ko e fokotuʻu ʻo ha database: ko e ngaahi teepile fē ʻo e fakamatala ʻoku ʻi ai, mo e meʻa ʻoku hū ki he taki taha.
gloss.sql.text: Ko e nounou ia ʻo e structured query language: ko e lea ʻoku ngāueʻaki ke kole ai ha fakamatala mei he ngaahi database tokolahi pe liliu ia.
gloss.data.text: Ko e fakamatala ʻoku tauhi ʻe ha komipiuta, hangē ko e ngaahi hingoa, ngaahi ʻota pe ngaahi fokotuʻu.
gloss.server.text: Ko ha komipiuta ʻoku tuku ʻā maʻu pē ʻo tali e ngaahi kole mei he ngaahi komipiuta kehe, hangē ko hono ʻomi ha peesi uepi ʻi he taimi ʻokú ke ʻaʻahi ai ki ai.
gloss.client.text: Ko e tafaʻaki ʻoku kole ha meʻa, ʻoku faʻa hoko ko hoʻo polauzā pe app, ʻo talanoa mo ha sēvā. ʻI he pisinisi ʻoku toe ʻuhinga pē ia ki ha kasitomā.
gloss.api.text: Ko e nounou ia ʻo e application programming interface: ko ha lisi kuo fokotuʻu ʻo e ngaahi kole ʻe lava ʻe ha polokalama ʻe taha ke fai ki ha taha kehe, hangē ko hono kole ki ha sēvesi ʻeá ʻa e tomuʻa tala ʻo e ʻaho ni.
gloss.endpoint.text: Ko ha meʻa ʻe taha ʻi he lisi ʻo ha API: ko ha tuʻasila uepi ʻoku lava ʻe ha polokalama ʻo ui ke maʻu pe fekau ha meʻa.
gloss.integration.text: Ko hono fakafehokotaki e ongo sisitemi ʻe ua ke na ngāue fakataha, hangē ko hoʻo falekoloa ʻoku fekau ʻene ngaahi ʻota ki hoʻo polokalama paʻanga.
gloss.webhook.text: Ko ha pōpoaki ʻoku fekau ʻe ha sisitemi ki ha sisitemi kehe ʻiate ia pē ʻi he taimi pē ʻoku hoko ai ha meʻa, hangē ko e “kuo maʻu e totongi”.
gloss.library.text: Ko e koti kuo teuteu naʻe tohi ʻe ha taha kehe ʻoku lava ke ke toe ngāueʻaki ʻo ʻikai ko hono tohi ʻe koe.
gloss.framework.text: Ko ha fokotuʻu kuo teuteu ki hono langa ha app ʻoku ne fakapapauʻi ha konga lahi ʻo e anga ʻo e fokotuʻu ʻo e koti, hangē ko ha tuʻunga fale ʻokú ke fakafonu.
gloss.sdk.text: Ko ha puha ʻo e ngaahi meʻangāue, koti mo e ngaahi sīpinga ki hono langa e polokalama ki ha tuʻunga pe sēvesi ʻe taha.
gloss.softdep.text: Ko ha library pe meʻangāue ʻoku fiemaʻu ʻe hoʻo koti ke ngāue. Ko hono fakafoʻou maʻu pē kinautolu ʻoku mahuʻinga ki he malu.
gloss.package.text: Ko ha fakatahaʻi ʻo e koti kuo teuteu ʻoku lava ke ke fokotuʻu mo ngāueʻaki ʻi ha poloseki.
gloss.pkgmgr.text: Ko ha meʻangāue ʻoku ne ʻomi mo fakafoʻou e ngaahi package ʻoku fakafalala ki ai hoʻo koti. Ko e npm ko ha taha angamaheni.
gloss.git.text: Ko e meʻangāue ʻoku ngāueʻaki lahi taha ki hono tauhi e hisitōlia ʻo e ngaahi liliu ʻo e koti, ʻi he ngaahi commit mo e branch.
gloss.github.text: Ko ha uepisaiti ʻoku tauhi ai e ngaahi repo Git ʻi he laine, ke lava ʻe he ngaahi timi ʻo vahevahe e koti, vakaiʻi e ngaahi liliu mo muimui ki he ngāue.
gloss.vcs.text: Ko hono tauhi ʻo ha hisitōlia kakato ʻo e liliu kotoa ki he ngaahi fail, ke ke sio ki he tokotaha naʻe liliu e hā pea lava ke foki kapau ʻoku fiemaʻu. Ko e Git ʻoku fai ʻeni.
gloss.clone.text: Ko hono ngaohi ha kopi kakato ʻaʻau ʻo ha repo, mo hono hisitōlia, ʻi hoʻo komipiuta.
gloss.pull.text: Ko hono ʻomi e ngaahi commit fakamuimui mei he kopi vahevahe (hangē ko e GitHub) ki hoʻo komipiuta. Ko e fakafepaki ia ʻo e push.
gloss.mainbranch.text: Ko e veesini ʻofisiale ʻo e koti ʻoku ngāue mei ai e tokotaha kotoa, ʻoku faʻa ui ko e main pe master.
gloss.conflict.text: Ko e taimi ʻoku ala ai e ongo liliu ki he ngaahi laine tatau ʻi he ngaahi founga kehekehe, ko ia ʻoku ʻikai lava ʻe he komipiuta ʻo fakatahaʻi ia pea ʻoku fiemaʻu ha tokotaha ke fili.
gloss.diff.text: Ko ha sio ʻoku fakahā totonu ai e meʻa naʻe liliu ʻi he vahaʻa ʻo e ongo veesini: ko e ngaahi laine kuo tānaki mo e ngaahi laine kuo toʻo.
gloss.fork.text: Ko hoʻo kopi ʻaʻau ʻo e repo ʻa ha taha kehe, ʻoku lava ke ke liliu taʻe ala ki he ʻene.
gloss.script.text: Ko ha polokalama nounou ʻoku fai ha ngāue ʻe taha ʻiate ia pē, hangē ko hono fakamaʻa e ngaahi fail pe kamataʻi e app.
gloss.build.text: Ko hono liliu e koti ki ha meʻa kuo teuteu ke lele, pe ko e ola kuo teuteu ke lele.
gloss.compile.text: Ko hono liliu e koti naʻe tohi ʻe he kakai ki ha fōtunga ʻoku lava ʻe he komipiuta ʻo lele fakahangatonu.
gloss.cli.text: Ko ha uinitou tohi ʻokú ke taipe ai e ngaahi fakahinohino ki he komipiuta ʻo ʻikai ko hono lomi. ʻOku ui foki ko e terminal.
gloss.config.text: Ko e ngaahi fokotuʻu ʻoku pule ki he anga ʻo e ngāue ʻa e polokalama, ʻoku tauhi kehe mei he koti ke faingofua hono liliu.
gloss.envvar.text: Ko ha fokotuʻu ʻoku ʻoatu ki ha polokalama ʻi he taimi ʻoku kamata ai, ʻoku faʻa ngāueʻaki ki he ngaahi tuʻasila pe lea fakaʻilonga ke ʻoua naʻa tohi ia ki he koti.
gloss.debugging.text: Ko hono kumi e ʻuhinga ʻoku ʻikai ngāue ai ha meʻa, pea fakalelei ia.
gloss.pairing.text: Ko e ongo tokotaha (pe ko ha tokotaha mo ha AI) ʻoku ngāue fakataha ʻi he koti tatau, ko e taha ʻoku taipe pea ko e taha ʻoku vakaiʻi.
gloss.docs.text: Ko e ngaahi fakamatala kuo tohi ki he anga ʻo e ngāue ʻa ha meʻa pe founga ke ngāueʻaki ia.
gloss.readme.text: Ko e fail ʻuluaki ke lau ʻi ha repo: ko e hā e poloseki pea founga ke kamata ia.
gloss.legacy.text: Ko ha sisitemi motuʻa ʻoku kei ngāueʻaki ka ʻoku faingataʻa hono liliu, ʻo faʻa koeʻuhí ʻoku tokosiʻi pē ʻa e kakai ʻoku kei mahino kiate kinautolu.
gloss.techdebt.text: Ko e ngaahi hala nounou ʻoku nau fakahaofi taimi he taimi ni ka ʻoku nau fakatuai e ngaahi liliu ʻamui, hangē ko ha nō ʻoku tupu ai hono tupu. ʻOku totongi māmālie ia ʻe he refactoring.
gloss.autotest.text: Ko ha sivi ʻoku fai ʻe he komipiuta ʻiate ia pē ʻi he liliu kotoa ʻo e koti, ke maʻu vave e ngaahi hala.
gloss.manualtest.text: Ko ha tokotaha ʻoku ne feinga ʻaki e nima ki he ngāue ke sio pe ʻoku ngāue ʻo hangē ko e totonu.
gloss.unittest.text: Ko ha sivi ʻauto siʻi ki ha konga koti ʻe taha pē.
gloss.integtest.text: Ko ha sivi ke sio pe ʻoku ngāue lelei fakataha e ngaahi konga ʻe niʻihi, ʻo ʻikai ko e taha pē ʻi he taimi ʻe taha.
gloss.endtoend.text: Ko ha sivi ʻoku ne fai ʻo hangē ko ha tokotaha ngāueʻaki moʻoni mei he kamata ki he ʻosi, hangē ko e hū, fakatau mo totongi.
gloss.uat.text: Ko e kakai naʻa nau kole e ngāue ʻoku nau sivi ia ʻe kinautolu pē pea tala pe ʻoku fakahoko e meʻa ʻoku nau fiemaʻu. Ko e puha sivi ʻa e AI-gile ko hono founga ia ʻo e meʻa ni.
gloss.regression.text: Ko ha meʻa naʻe ngāue ka kuo maumau hili ha liliu. Ko e ngaahi sivi regression ʻoku nau sivi pe ʻoku kei ngāue e ngaahi meʻa motuʻa.
gloss.smoke.text: Ko ha sivi vave fau ke sio pe ʻoku ngāue e ngaahi meʻa tefito, hangē ko e hili pē ʻa e hū ʻo ha liliu ki he laine. Kapau ʻoku tō, taʻofi pea vakai.
gloss.exploratory.text: Ko hono feinga ʻo e koloa ʻi he anga tauʻatāina pea ngāueʻaki ia ʻi he ngaahi founga kehekehe, ke maʻu e ngaahi palopalema ʻe ʻikai maʻu ʻe he ngaahi sivi kuo palani.
gloss.testcase.text: Ko ha fakamatala ʻe taha kuo tohi ke feinga: ko e ngaahi sitepu mo e meʻa ʻoku totonu ke hoko.
gloss.coverage.text: Ko e lahi ʻo e koti ʻoku sivi ʻe he ngaahi sivi ʻauto. Ko e lahi ange ʻoku faʻa malu ange, ka ʻoku ʻikai fakamoʻoni ʻe he coverage māʻolunga pē ʻoku ngāue lelei.
gloss.testdata.text: Ko e fakamatala sīpinga kuo ngaohi ʻoku ngāueʻaki ʻi he sivi, ke ʻoua naʻa fakahā ha fakamatala fakafoʻituitui ʻa ha tokotaha moʻoni.
gloss.edgecase.text: Ko ha tuʻunga kehe ʻi he ngataʻanga, hangē ko ha foomu maha pe ko ha hingoa mo ha ʻapositofi, ʻa ia ʻoku faʻa maumau ai e ngaahi meʻa.
gloss.happypath.text: Ko e hala angamaheni ʻoku lelei ai e meʻa kotoa. Ko e sivi lelei ʻoku feinga foki ki he ngaahi hala ʻikai fiefia.
gloss.perftest.text: Ko hono sivi ʻo e vave ʻo ha meʻa mo e anga ʻo hono kei tuʻu lelei ʻi he mamafa.
gloss.loadtest.text: Ko hono sivi ʻo e anga ʻo e tuʻu ʻa ha sisitemi ʻi he taimi ʻoku ngāueʻaki ai ia ʻe he kakai tokolahi fakataha.
gloss.sectest.text: Ko hono kumi e ngaahi vaivai ʻe ala tuku ai ha taha ke ngāueʻaki kovi ha sisitemi pe sio ki he meʻa ʻoku ʻikai totonu ke ne sio ki ai.
gloss.accesstest.text: Ko hono sivi pe ʻoku lava ʻe he kakai ʻoku kehekehe honau malava ʻo ngāueʻaki e koloa, kau ai mo hono ngāueʻaki ha screen reader pe ko e keyboard pē.
gloss.linting.text: Ko ha sivi ʻauto ʻoku ne maʻu e ngaahi hala ʻoku ngalingali mo e fōtunga veve ʻi he koti, hangē ko ha sivi sipela ki he ngaahi polokalama.
gloss.static.text: Ko hono sivi e koti ki he ngaahi palopalema ʻaki hono lau ʻauto, taʻe lele ia.
gloss.flaky.text: Ko ha sivi ʻoku taimi ʻe niʻihi ʻoku lava pea taimi ʻe niʻihi ʻoku tō taʻe ha ʻuhinga mahino, ko ia ʻoku ʻikai lava ke falala kakato ki ai.
gloss.repro.text: Ko hono fakahoko fakataumuʻa ke toe hoko ha bug ʻaki hono muimui ki he ngaahi sitepu tatau, ke lava ʻo ako mo fakalelei ia. Ko hono tohi e ngaahi sitepu ko ia ko e konga ia ʻoku ʻaonga taha ʻi ha lipooti bug.
gloss.severity.text: Ko e anga ʻo e kovi ʻo e ola ʻo ha palopalema, mei ha fakamāfasia siʻi ki he tuʻu e meʻa kotoa.
gloss.devops.text: Ko ha founga ngāue ʻoku ngāue fakataha ai e kakai ʻoku nau langa e polokalama mo e kakai ʻoku nau fakalele ia ko ha timi ʻe taha, mo e ʻauto lahi, ke faʻa hū e ngaahi liliu ki he laine pea ʻi he malu.
gloss.cicd.text: Ko e ngaahi liliu ʻa e tokotaha kotoa ʻoku faʻa fakatahaʻi ki he veesini tefito pea sivi ʻauto he taimi kotoa (continuous integration), ko ia ʻoku mateuteu maʻu pē e polokalama ke hū ki he laine ʻaki ha lomi ʻe taha (continuous delivery).
gloss.contdeploy.text: Ko ha sitepu ʻe taha ki muʻa ʻi he continuous delivery: ko e liliu kotoa pē ʻoku lava ʻi he ngaahi sivi ʻoku hū ki he laine ʻiate ia pē, taʻe ha puha ke lomi.
gloss.pipeline.text: Ko e hokohoko ʻauto ʻo e ngaahi sitepu ʻoku fakalaka ai ha liliu ʻi hono hala ki he laine, hangē ko e build, sivi, pea deploy.
gloss.environment.text: Ko ha kopi kehe ʻe taha ʻo e sisitemi ki ha taumuʻa ʻe taha, hangē ko ha taha ke langa ai, ha taha ke sivi ai mo e taha ʻoku ʻi he laine.
gloss.devenv.text: Ko e kopi ʻoku ngāue ai ha tokotaha langa, ʻoku faʻa ʻi hono komipiuta pē, ʻa ia ʻoku ʻikai uesia ai ha taha ʻi hono maumauʻi e ngaahi meʻa.
gloss.testenv.text: Ko ha kopi kehe ʻo e sisitemi ʻoku ngāueʻaki ki he sivi pē, ke ʻoua naʻa ala ki he sēvesi moʻoni.
gloss.staging.text: Ko ha kopi fakaʻosi kuo fokotuʻu tatau pē mo e laine, ki ha sivi fakaʻosi kimuʻa pea hū ha liliu ki he laine.
gloss.artifact.text: Ko e fail pe fakatahaʻi ʻoku ngaohi ʻe ha build, kuo teuteu ke tauhi, sivi pe fakahū ki he laine.
gloss.hotfix.text: Ko ha fakalelei fakavavevave ʻoku hū vave ki he laine, ʻi tuʻa mei he palani angamaheni, koeʻuhi kuo maumau ha meʻa mahuʻinga.
gloss.patch.text: Ko ha fakafoʻou siʻi ʻoku ne fakalelei ha bug pe tāpuni ha ava malu. Ko hono fakahoko vave e ngaahi security patch ʻoku mahuʻinga.
gloss.version.text: Ko ha fakaʻilonga hangē ko e 2.4.1 ʻoku ne tala pe ko e hā e tukuange ʻokú ke maʻu. ʻOku faʻa liliu e fika ʻuluaki ki he ngaahi liliu lalahi pea mo e fika fakaʻosi ki he ngaahi fakalelei siʻi.
gloss.relnotes.text: Ko ha lisi nounou mo faingofua ʻo e meʻa naʻe liliu ʻi ha tukuange, maʻá e kakai ʻoku nau ngāueʻaki ia, kau ai e ngaahi fakalelei mo e ngaahi ngataʻanga ʻoku ʻiloa. ʻOku ui foki ko e changelog.
gloss.flag.text: Ko ha sūisi ke fakaʻā pe tāmateʻi ha feature, ke lava ʻo hū e ngāue foʻou ki he laine kuo fufū pea fakaʻā (pe toe tāmateʻi) taʻe ha tukuange foʻou.
gloss.rollfwd.text: Ko hono fakalelei ha tukuange kovi ʻaki hono tuku vave atu ha veesini foʻou kuo tonu, ʻo ʻikai ko hono foki ki he veesini motuʻa.
gloss.canary.text: Ko hono hū ha liliu ki he laine ki ha kulupu siʻi ʻuluaki, pea ki he tokotaha kotoa ʻi he taimi pē ʻoku hā lelei ai. Naʻe fakahingoa ia ki he ngaahi kanalī naʻe ʻave ʻe he kau keli ki lalo ko ha fakatokanga ʻuluaki.
gloss.bluegreen.text: Ko hono tauhi ʻo e ongo kopi ʻo e sisitemi ʻi he laine pea fakahiki e kakai ki he foʻou ʻi he taimi ʻe taha, ke lava ʻo foki vave kapau ʻoku hala.
gloss.zerodown.text: Ko hono hū ha veesini foʻou ki he laine taʻe tuʻu ʻa e sēvesi ki he kau ngāueʻaki.
gloss.chgenable.text: Ko hono tokoni ke lavameʻa e ngaahi liliu: ko hono fua e fakatuʻutāmaki, maʻu e fakangofua totonu mo fili ha taimi lelei. ʻOku ui foki ko e change management.
gloss.cab.text: Ko ha kulupu ʻoku ne vakaiʻi e ngaahi liliu mahuʻinga pea loto taha pe ʻe lava ke fai mo e taimi fē.
gloss.stdchange.text: Ko ha liliu fakatuʻutāmaki siʻi ʻoku fai ʻi he founga tatau kuo ʻosi sivi ʻi he taimi kotoa, ko ia ʻoku fakangofua ia ki muʻa.
gloss.normchange.text: Ko ha liliu ʻoku fiemaʻu ke vakaiʻi mo fakangofua kimuʻa pea fai.
gloss.emergchange.text: Ko ha liliu ʻoku totonu ke fai leva ke fakalelei pe taʻofi ha palopalema lahi, mo ha fakangofua vave ke tatau.
gloss.automation.text: Ko hono tuku ke fai ʻe he komipiuta ʻiate ia pē ha ngāue ʻoku toutou fai, ke vave ange pea fai tatau he taimi kotoa.
gloss.infra.text: Ko e ngaahi mīsini, kupenga mo e ngaahi sēvesi ʻoku lele ai e polokalama.
gloss.iac.text: Ko hono fakamatala ʻo hoʻo ngaahi sēvā mo e ngaahi fokotuʻu ʻi he ngaahi fail ʻoku tauhi fakataha mo e koti, ke lava ʻo toe langa tatau ʻi he taimi kotoa.
gloss.cloud.text: Ko hono totongi ʻo e ngaahi komipiuta, tauhi mo e ngaahi sēvesi mei ha timi lahi ʻi he ʻinitaneti, ʻo ʻikai ke ke maʻu pē ʻe koe ʻa e ngaahi mīsini.
gloss.provider.text: Ko ha timi pisinisi ʻoku ne tuku totongi atu ha komipiuta ʻi he ʻinitaneti, hangē ko e Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure pe Google Cloud.
gloss.hosting.text: Ko e feituʻu ʻoku nofo mo lele ai hoʻo app pe uepisaiti ke lava ʻe he kakai ʻo aʻu ki ai, ʻoku faʻa totongi ia mei ha timi.
gloss.domain.text: Ko e tuʻasila uepi ʻoku taipe ʻe he kakai, hangē ko e example.com. ʻOkú ke totongi ia ʻi he taʻu taki taha, ko ia ʻoku totonu ke toe fakafoʻou.
gloss.dns.text: Ko e nounou ia ʻo e domain name system: ko e tohi tuʻasila ʻo e ʻinitaneti, ʻoku liliu ai ha hingoa hangē ko e example.com ki he tuʻasila ʻo e komipiuta totonu.
gloss.container.text: Ko ha pēkesi tāpuni ʻoku ʻi ai ha app mo e meʻa kotoa ʻoku fiemaʻu ai, ke lele tatau ʻi he komipiuta pē. Ko e Docker ʻoku ʻiloa lelei taha.
gloss.vm.text: Ko ha komipiuta fakatātā ʻoku lele ʻi loto ʻi ha komipiuta moʻoni, ke lava ʻe ha mīsini lahi ʻe taha ʻo hoko ʻo hangē ha ngaahi mīsini lahi.
gloss.serverless.text: Ko hono lele ʻo e koti taʻe tokangaʻi ha sēvā ʻe koe: ʻoku fakalele ia ʻe he provider ʻi he taimi pē ʻoku fiemaʻu pea ʻokú ke totongi pē e meʻa ʻokú ke ngāueʻaki.
gloss.lb.text: Ko ha meʻa ʻoku ne vahevahe e kau ʻaʻahi ki he ngaahi sēvā tokolahi, ko ia ʻoku ʻikai fonu fau ha taha.
gloss.cache.text: Ko ha tauhi ofi ʻo e ngaahi ola fakamuimui, ke ʻoua naʻa toe ʻomi pe toe fai e meʻa tatau. Ko hono fakamaʻa ʻoku lava ke ne fakalelei e ngaahi peesi ʻoku hā motuʻa.
gloss.cdn.text: Ko ha fakatahaʻi ʻo e ngaahi sēvā ʻi he māmani kotoa ʻoku tauhi ai e ngaahi kopi ʻo hoʻo ngaahi peesi mo e ngaahi tā ʻo ofi ki hoʻo kau ʻaʻahi, ke vave hono hū.
gloss.migration.text: Ko hono hiki ʻo e data pe ngaahi sisitemi mei ha fokotuʻu motuʻa ki ha foʻou, pe ko hono liliu fakalelei ʻo e fokotuʻu ʻo ha database.
gloss.svcmgmt.text: Ko e meʻa kotoa ʻoku kau ki hono tauhi ʻo ha sēvesi ke ʻaonga mo ngāue maʻá e kakai ʻoku nau falala ki ai, ʻaho he ʻaho.
gloss.itil.text: Ko ha tohi fakahinohino ʻoku ngāueʻaki lahi ki he tokanga lelei ki he sēvesi, ʻoku kau ai e ngaahi meʻa fakatuʻupakē, palopalema mo e ngaahi liliu. Naʻe ʻuhinga ʻa e hingoa ki muʻa ki he IT Infrastructure Library.
gloss.itsm.text: Ko hono fakalele ʻo e tekinolosia ko ha sēvesi maʻá e kakai, mo e ngaahi founga mahino ke tokangaʻi e ngaahi kole, meʻa fakatuʻupakē, liliu mo e ngaahi fakalelei.
gloss.managed.text: Ko ha sēvesi ʻoku fakalele mo tokangaʻi ʻe ha taha kehe maʻau, ʻi lalo ʻo ha loto taha ki he anga ʻo e lelei ʻo hono ngāue.
gloss.svcowner.text: Ko e tokotaha ʻoku ne fua e fatongia ʻo ha sēvesi kakato: ko e lelei ʻo ʻene ngāue, ko e hā hono fakamole mo e founga ʻoku fakalelei ai.
gloss.sla.text: Ko ha talaʻofa kuo tohi ki he kau kasitomā ki he anga ʻo e lelei ʻo e ngāue ʻa e sēvesi, hangē ko e “ʻoku ngāue 99.9% ʻo e taimi” pe “tali ʻi loto ʻi he houa ʻe taha”, ʻo faʻa foki mai ha paʻanga kapau ʻe maumauʻi e talaʻofa.
gloss.slo.text: Ko e taumuʻa ʻa e timi ʻiate ia pē ki he anga ʻo e lelei ʻo e ngāue ʻa e sēvesi ʻi ha vahaʻa taimi, ʻoku faʻa fokotuʻu ia ʻo kiʻi māʻolunga ange ʻi he SLA ke malu.
gloss.sli.text: Ko e fua moʻoni ʻokú ke sivi ki ha taumuʻa, hangē ko e vahenga ʻo e ngaahi ʻaʻahi naʻe hū lelei.
gloss.uptimepct.text: Ko e lahi ʻo e taimi ʻoku ngāue ai ha sēvesi, ʻoku faʻa fakahā ʻaki ha pēseti. Ko e 99.9% ʻoku kei fakangofua ai ke tuʻu ha miniti ʻe 43 nai ʻi he mahina.
gloss.availability.text: Pe ʻoku lava ʻe he kakai ʻo ngāueʻaki ha sēvesi ʻi he taimi ʻoku nau fiemaʻu ai, ʻoku faʻa fua ʻaki e uptime.
gloss.downtime.text: Ko e taimi ʻoku ʻikai ngāue ai ha sēvesi pe tāpuni, kuo palani pe ʻikai.
gloss.errorbudget.text: Ko e kiʻi lahi ʻo e tō ʻoku fakangofua ʻe hoʻo taumuʻa ki he falalaʻanga ʻo e sēvesi. Lolotonga ʻoku kei toe ha konga, te ke lava ʻo fai ha ngaahi liliu ʻoku ʻi ai hano fakatuʻutāmaki; ka ʻosi ia, ʻokú ke fakamāmālie.
gloss.outage.text: Ko ha taimi ʻoku tuʻu ai ha sēvesi pe maumau kovi ʻaupito maʻá e kau ngāueʻaki.
gloss.degraded.text: ʻOku ngāue, ka ʻoku kovi: tuai, pe ʻoku ʻikai ngāue ha ngaahi konga.
gloss.monitoring.text: Ko hono sio ʻauto ki ha sēvesi he taimi kotoa, ke maʻu e ngaahi palopalema, ʻo lelei taha kapau ʻe maʻu kimuʻa pea ʻilo ʻe he kau ngāueʻaki.
gloss.observability.text: Ko e lelei ʻo hoʻo malava ke ʻilo e meʻa ʻoku hoko ʻi loto ʻi ha sisitemi mei tuʻa, ʻaki hono ngaahi log, fika mo e ngaahi trace.
gloss.log.text: Ko ha tohi ʻaho hokohoko ʻoku tauhi ʻe ha polokalama ki he meʻa ʻoku ne fai, ʻoku ngāueʻaki ke mahino ko e hā naʻe hala.
gloss.trace.text: Ko ha lekooti ki he fononga ʻo ha kole ʻe taha ʻi he ngaahi konga kehekehe ʻo ha sisitemi, sitepu ʻe sitepu, ʻo fakahā e feituʻu naʻe tuai ai.
gloss.latency.text: Ko e fuoloa ʻo e tali ʻa ha meʻa, hangē ko e tatali mei he lomi ki he ʻasi mai ʻo e peesi.
gloss.alert.text: Ko ha pōpoaki ʻauto ʻoku tala ai ʻoku fiemaʻu ha tokanga ki ha meʻa, hangē ko e ʻikai tali ʻa e uepisaiti.
gloss.alertfatigue.text: Ko e taimi ʻoku lahi fau ai e ngaahi fakatokanga ʻo kamata ai ke ʻikai tokanga ki ai e kakai, kau ai mo e ngaahi fakatokanga mahuʻinga.
gloss.dashboard.text: Ko ha sikilini ʻoku fakahā ai e ngaahi fika mo e tuʻunga mahuʻinga taha ʻi ha sio ʻe taha.
gloss.paging.text: Ko hono telefoni vave pe fafangu ʻo e tokotaha ʻoku tokanga (on-call) ki ha palopalema.
gloss.escalation.text: Ko hono ʻomi ha taha ʻoku lahi ange hono poto pe mafai ʻi he taimi ʻoku ʻikai lava ai ke fakalelei ha palopalema ʻi he tuʻunga ko ia, pe ʻikai vave feʻunga.
gloss.triage.text: Ko hono vaheʻi vave e ngaahi palopalema ʻoku hū mai ʻo fakatatau ki hono fakavavevave mo hono mahuʻinga, ke tokangaʻi ʻuluaki e kovi taha.
gloss.impact.text: Ko e lahi ʻo hono uesia ʻe ha meʻa ʻa e kakai: ko e toko fiha, mo e kovi fēfē.
gloss.urgency.text: Ko e vave ʻoku fiemaʻu ai ke tokangaʻi ha meʻa. Ko e impact mo e urgency fakataha ʻoku nau fokotuʻu e tuʻunga mahuʻinga.
gloss.plevels.text: Ko e ngaahi fakaʻilonga ki he fakavavevave ʻo ha palopalema. Ko e P1 ko e mamafa taha pea ʻoku fiemaʻu ha ngāue leva.
gloss.queue.text: Ko e lisi ʻo e ngaahi kole mo e ngaahi meʻa fakatuʻupakē ʻoku tatali ke toʻo.
gloss.tiers.word: Laine ʻuluaki mo e laine hono ua
gloss.tiers.text: Ko e ngaahi tuʻunga ʻo e tokoni: ko e laine ʻuluaki ʻoku ne tali e telefoni pea fakalelei e ngaahi meʻa faingofua; ko e laine hono ua ʻoku lahi ange hono poto ki he ngaahi meʻa faingataʻa. ʻOku ui foki ko e tier 1 mo e tier 2.
gloss.ic.word: Incident commander (taki ʻo e meʻa fakatuʻupakē)
gloss.ic.text: Ko e tokotaha ʻe taha ʻoku ne taki e tali ki ha meʻa fakatuʻupakē, ke ʻilo ʻe he tokotaha kotoa pe ko hai ʻoku ne fili pea ko hai ʻoku ne fai e hā.
gloss.responsetime.text: Ko e fuoloa kimuʻa pea ʻuluaki toʻo ʻe ha taha ha kole pe meʻa fakatuʻupakē.
gloss.resolution.text: Ko e fuoloa ke fakalelei kakato ha kole pe meʻa fakatuʻupakē, mei he lipooti ki hono fakalelei.
gloss.mttr.text: ʻI he ʻavalisi, ko e fuoloa ke toe ngāue ha sēvesi hili hono maumau. Ko e MTTR ʻoku lava ke ʻuhinga siʻi kehekehe, ko ia tala ko e hā ʻokú ke fua.
gloss.mtbf.text: ʻI he ʻavalisi, ko e fuoloa ʻoku lele ai ha sēvesi kimuʻa pea maumau ha meʻa.
gloss.cmdb.text: Ko e lisi ʻo e ngaahi meʻa fokotuʻu kotoa (configuration items) mo e anga ʻo e fehokotaki ʻa e taha mo e taha, ke ke sio ki he meʻa ʻoku fakafalala ki he hā.
gloss.asset.text: Ko ha meʻa pē ʻoku mahuʻinga ʻokú ke maʻu pe totongi ke fakalele e sēvesi, hangē ko ha lepitopu, ha laisensi polokalama pe ha domain.
gloss.capplan.text: Ko hono fakapapauʻi ʻe ʻi ai e mālohi komipiuta, tauhi mo e kakai feʻunga ki he meʻa ʻoku ʻalu mai.
gloss.scaling.text: Ko hono matuʻuaki ʻo e kau ngāueʻaki tokolahi ange ʻaki hono foaki ha mālohi lahi ange ki ha mīsini (scaling up) pe tānaki ha ngaahi mīsini lahi ange (scaling out).
gloss.bcp.also: business continuity plan,hokohoko ʻo e pisinisi
gloss.bcp.text: Ko e ngaahi palani ke hokohoko atu e ngaahi meʻa mahuʻinga ʻi he taimi ʻoku hala ai ha meʻa lahi, hangē ko e mole ha ʻōfisi, ha tokotaha ʻomi koloa mahuʻinga pe ngaahi komipiuta.
gloss.dr.also: disaster recovery,toe fakafoki mei he mala
gloss.dr.text: Ko e palani mo e ngaahi meʻangāue ke toe maʻu ha sēvesi hili ha meʻa lahi, hangē ko e mole ʻo ha senitā data kakato.
gloss.rto.text: Ko e fuoloa taha ʻe lava ke tuʻu ai ha sēvesi hili ha mala kimuʻa pea totonu ke toe ngāue.
gloss.rpo.text: Ko e lahi taha ʻo e data foʻou ʻe lava ke ke tali ke mole, ʻoku fua ʻaki e taimi. Ko ha RPO ʻo e houa ʻe taha ʻoku ʻuhinga ia ʻoku fiemaʻu ha kopi maluʻi ʻi he houa kotoa pē ʻi he siʻi taha.
gloss.redundancy.text: Ko hono ʻi ai ʻo e ngaahi meʻa fetongi kuo teuteu, hangē ko ha sēvā hono ua, ke ʻoua naʻa taʻofi e sēvesi ʻe ha tō ʻe taha.
gloss.failover.text: Ko hono hiki ʻiate ia pē ki ha sisitemi fetongi ʻi he taimi ʻoku tō ai e sisitemi angamaheni.
gloss.spof.text: Ko ha konga ʻe taha ʻoku ne fakatō fakataha mo ia e meʻa kotoa ʻi he taimi ʻoku maumau ai, koeʻuhí ʻoku ʻikai ha fetongi.
gloss.maintwin.text: Ko ha taimi kuo palani ʻe ala tuʻu ai pe tuai ha sēvesi ki he tauhi, kuo fakahā ki he kau ngāueʻaki ki muʻa.
gloss.handover.text: Ko hono foaki ʻo e ngāue, ʻilo mo e fatongia ki ha tokotaha pe timi kehe, ke ʻoua naʻa mole ha meʻa.
gloss.kb.text: Ko ha fakatahaʻi ʻo e ngaahi tohi tokoni mo e ngaahi tali, maʻá e kau ngāueʻaki mo e timi.
gloss.csat.text: Ko ha sikoa mei he kau ngāueʻaki ʻoku nau tala ai ʻenau fiefia, ʻoku faʻa fehuʻi hili hono tāpuni ha kole.
gloss.supplier.text: Ko ha timi pisinisi ʻi tuʻa ʻokú ke falala ki ai, hangē ko hoʻo hosting provider. ʻOku ui foki ko e vendor pe third party.
gloss.retire.text: Ko hono tāpuni ha sēvesi ʻo ʻikai toe ngāue, ʻi he anga malu: tala ki he kau ngāueʻaki, tokangaʻi ʻene fakamatala mo e hū, pea taʻofi ʻene ngaahi fakamole.
gloss.eol.text: Ko e taimi ʻoku ʻikai toe maʻu ai ʻe ha koloa ha ngaahi fakafoʻou pe tokoni mei hono tokotaha ngaohi, ko ia ʻoku totonu ke fetongi.
gloss.cybersec.text: Ko hono maluʻi ʻo e ngaahi sisitemi mo e data mei he hū fakamālohi, kaihaʻasi pe maumau.
gloss.authn.text: Ko hono sivi pe ko hai ha taha, ʻaki ha lea fakaʻilonga pe koti. ʻOku faʻa nounouʻi ko e authn.
gloss.authz.text: Ko hono sivi ʻa e meʻa ʻoku fakangofua ke fai ʻe ha taha hili ʻa e ʻilo pe ko hai ia. ʻOku faʻa nounouʻi ko e authz.
gloss.mfa.text: Ko hono hū ʻaki ha fakamoʻoni ʻe ua pe lahi ange, hangē ko ha lea fakaʻilonga mo ha koti ʻi hoʻo telefoni. ʻOku ui foki ko e two-factor (2FA).
gloss.sso.text: Ko hono hū ʻo tuʻo taha ke aʻu ki he ngaahi sisitemi lahi, hangē ko hono ngāueʻaki hoʻo akauni ngāue ʻi he potu kotoa.
gloss.pwmgr.text: Ko ha app ʻoku ne ngaohi ha ngaahi lea fakaʻilonga mālohi pea manatuʻi ia maʻau.
gloss.secret.text: Ko ha lea fakaʻilonga, kī pe koti fakafoʻituitui kehe ʻoku ngāueʻaki ʻe ha polokalama ke hū ki ha meʻa. ʻOku totonu ke ʻoua naʻa vahevahe pe tohi ia ki he koti.
gloss.apikey.text: Ko ha koti fakafufū ʻoku tuku ai ha polokalama ke ngāueʻaki e API ʻo ha sēvesi kehe, pea fakahā ai ko hai ʻoku ngāueʻaki (mo totongi) ia.
gloss.accesstoken.text: Ko ha tikite fakataimi ʻoku fakamoʻoni ai ʻoku fakangofua ha polokalama ke hū, ko ia ʻoku ʻikai fiemaʻu hoʻo lea fakaʻilonga he taimi kotoa. ʻIkai tatau mo ha token AI.
gloss.encryption.text: Ko hono fakafaikehe ʻo e fakamatala ke lava pē ʻe ha taha mo e kī totonu ʻo lau ia.
gloss.https.text: Ko e founga malu ʻoku fononga ai e ngaahi peesi uepi, ʻoku fakahā ʻe he loka ʻi hoʻo polauzā, ke ʻoua naʻa lau pe liliu ia ʻe ha taha ʻi he vahaʻa.
gloss.cert.text: Ko ha kaati ID fakadikitā ʻoku lava ai ʻe ha uepisaiti ʻo fakamoʻoni pe ko hai ia mo ngāueʻaki e HTTPS. ʻOku ʻosi hono taimi, ko ia ʻoku totonu ke toe fakafoʻou.
gloss.permissions.text: Ko e ngaahi lao pe ko hai ʻe lava ʻo sio pe liliu e hā.
gloss.leastpriv.text: Ko hono foaki ki he tokotaha mo e polokalama taki taha ʻa e hū pē ʻoku nau fiemaʻu moʻoni, ki he fuoloa pē ʻoku nau fiemaʻu ai.
gloss.rbac.text: Ko hono foaki e hū ʻaki e fatongia, hangē ko e viewer pe editor, ʻo ʻikai ko e tokotaha ʻe tokotaha.
gloss.vuln.text: Ko ha vaivai ʻe lava ʻe ha taha ʻo ngāueʻaki ke hū fakamālohi pe fakatupu maumau.
gloss.zeroday.text: Ko ha vaivai ʻoku ʻilo ʻe he kau fakahala ʻi he teʻeki ai ke maʻu ʻe he kau ngaohi ha taimi ke fakalelei ai.
gloss.malware.text: Ko e polokalama kovi, hangē ko e vailasi, kuo ngaohi ke maumau, sio fufū pe kaihaʻasi.
gloss.ransomware.text: Ko ha malware ʻoku ne loka hoʻo ngaahi fail pea kole paʻanga ke toʻo e loka. Ko e ngaahi kopi maluʻi lelei ko e maluʻi lelei taha ia.
gloss.phishing.text: Ko e ngaahi pōpoaki loi ʻoku feinga ke kākaaʻi koe ke ke foaki atu ha lea fakaʻilonga pe paʻanga, pe fakaava ha meʻa kovi.
gloss.socialeng.text: Ko hono kākaaʻi e kakai, ʻo ʻikai ko e ngaahi komipiuta, ke foaki ha hū, hangē ko ha telefoni loi mei he “IT support”.
gloss.firewall.text: Ko ha leʻo ʻoku ne fili ko e hā e fetuʻutaki kupenga ʻe lava ke hū mai pe ʻalu atu.
gloss.vpn.text: Ko e nounou ia ʻo e virtual private network: ko ha fehokotaki fakafoʻituitui mo fakafufū ʻi he ʻinitaneti, ʻoku faʻa ngāueʻaki ke aʻu malu ki he ngaahi sisitemi ʻo e ngāue.
gloss.ddos.text: Ko hono fonu e sēvesi ʻaki ha fetuʻutaki loi lahi fau ke ʻikai lava ʻe he kakai moʻoni ʻo ngāueʻaki. Ko e DDoS ʻoku ʻuhinga ʻoku ʻomi mei he ngaahi komipiuta tokolahi fakataha.
gloss.pentest.text: Ko hono totongi ha kau mataotao anga-lelei ke feinga ke hū fakamālohi, ke maʻu e ngaahi vaivai kimuʻa pea maʻu ʻe he kau fakahala moʻoni.
gloss.audit.text: Ko ha sivi fakalelei ki he anga ʻo e maluʻi ʻo ha meʻa, ʻo fakahoa ki ha lisi ʻo e ngaahi founga lelei.
gloss.threatmodel.text: Ko hono fakakaukau ki he tokotaha ʻe ala fakahala ki ha meʻa, anga fēfē, pea ko e hā te ke fai ke taʻofi kinautolu.
gloss.breach.text: Ko e taimi ʻoku hola ai e fakamatala fakafoʻituitui ki he kakai ʻoku ʻikai totonu ke nau maʻu, pe mole pe liliu taʻe fakangofua.
gloss.pii.text: Ko ha fakamatala pē ki ha tokotaha ʻoku lava ke ʻiloʻi, hangē ko e hingoa, tuʻasila meili pe feituʻu. ʻOku ui foki ko e PII.
gloss.gdpr.text: Ko e lao ʻa ʻEulope ki he fakamatala fakafoʻituitui (ʻoku ʻi ai ha veesini ʻa Pilitānia): tānaki pē e meʻa ʻokú ke fiemaʻu, tauhi malu ia, pea tuku ke sio pe holoki ʻe he kakai ʻenau meʻa.
gloss.dataprot.text: Ko hono tokangaʻi lelei ʻo e fakamatala fakafoʻituitui mo ʻi loto ʻi he lao.
gloss.privacypolicy.text: Ko ha peesi ʻoku hā ki he kakai kotoa ʻoku pehē ai ko e hā e fakamatala fakafoʻituitui ʻokú ke tānaki, ko e hā ʻokú ke tānaki ai, mo e meʻa ʻokú ke fai ki ai.
gloss.consent.text: Ko e “ʻio” mahino mo tauʻatāina ʻa ha tokotaha ki hono ngāueʻaki ʻo ʻene fakamatala ʻi ha founga pau. Te ne lava ʻo toʻo ia he taimi pē.
gloss.cookie.text: Ko ha fail siʻi ʻoku tauhi ʻe ha uepisaiti ʻi hoʻo polauzā ke manatuʻi ha ngaahi meʻa, hangē ko hoʻo hū. Ko e niʻihi ʻoku fiemaʻu ai hoʻo loto-lelei ʻuluaki.
gloss.minimisation.text: Ko hono tānaki mo tauhi pē e fakamatala fakafoʻituitui ʻoku fiemaʻu moʻoni ki he ngāue.
gloss.retention.text: Ko e fuoloa ʻo hono tauhi e fakamatala kimuʻa pea holoki. Ko hono tauhi ia ʻo ʻikai lōloa ange ʻi he fiemaʻu ʻoku malu ange pea ʻoku faʻa fiemaʻu ʻe he lao.
gloss.anon.text: Ko hono liliu e fakamatala ke ʻoua naʻa toe lava ʻo ʻiloʻi ha taha mei ai.
gloss.pseudo.text: Ko hono fetongi e ngaahi hingoa mo e ngaahi fakaikiiki kehe ʻaki ha ngaahi koti, kae tauhi kehe ha kī ʻe lava ke toe fakafehokotaki ʻaki kinautolu ki he kakai. ʻOku kei lau pē ia ko e fakamatala fakafoʻituitui.
gloss.dpa.text: Ko ha kontalaka ʻoku pehē ai e anga ʻo e tokangaʻi ʻe ha tokotaha ʻomi koloa e fakamatala fakafoʻituitui maʻau.
gloss.dpia.text: Ko ha vakai fakalelei, kimuʻa pea kamata, ki he anga ʻe lava ke uesia ai ʻa e kakai ʻe ha palani ke ngāueʻaki e fakamatala fakafoʻituitui, pea mo e founga ke fakasiʻisiʻi ai e ngaahi fakatuʻutāmaki.
gloss.auditlog.text: Ko ha lekooti ʻo e tokotaha naʻe fai e hā mo e taimi fē, ke lava ʻo vakaiʻi e ngaahi ngāue ʻi he kimui.
gloss.compliance.text: Ko hono muimui ki he ngaahi lao, tuʻutuʻuni mo e ngaahi tuʻunga ʻoku ngāue kiate koe, pea lava ke fakahā ʻokú ke fai.
gloss.iso.text: Ko ha tuʻunga fakaemāmani ʻoku ʻiloa lelei ki hono pule ʻo e malu ʻo e fakamatala. ʻE lava ke maʻu ʻe ha timi ha tohi fakamoʻoni ʻoku nau muimui ki ai.
gloss.soc.text: Ko ha lipooti ʻAmelika, kuo sivi ʻe he kau sivi mei tuʻa, ʻoku fakahā ai ʻoku tokangaʻi lelei ʻe ha timi e fakamatala ʻa e kau kasitomā.
gloss.ai.text: Ko e ngaahi sisitemi komipiuta ʻoku nau fai e ngaahi meʻa ʻoku tau faʻa fakakaukau ʻoku fiemaʻu ai ha tokotaha, hangē ko hono tohi, tali fehuʻi pe ʻiloʻi tā.
gloss.ml.text: Ko ha founga ke ako ai ʻe he ngaahi komipiuta ʻa e ngaahi meʻa ʻoku toutou hā mei ha ngaahi sīpinga lahi, ʻo ʻikai ko hono foaki ha ngaahi lao tonu.
gloss.model.text: Ko e “ʻatamai” kuo akoʻi ʻo ha sisitemi AI, naʻe langa ʻaki hono ako mei ha ngaahi sīpinga lahi fau. ʻOku kehekehe e ngaahi mōtēle ʻi honau poto, vave mo e totongi.
gloss.llm.text: Ko ha mōtēle AI kuo akoʻi ʻaki ha tohi lahi fau, ke lava ʻo lau mo tohi lea.
gloss.genai.text: Ko e AI ʻoku ne ngaohi ha ngaahi meʻa foʻou, hangē ko e tohi, tā pe koti, ʻo ʻikai ko hono vaheʻi pe ʻiloʻi pē.
gloss.chatbot.text: Ko ha polokalama ʻokú ke talanoa mo ia ʻi he lea angamaheni, ʻaki hono taipe pe lea.
gloss.prompt.text: Ko e meʻa ʻokú ke foaki ki ha AI: hoʻo fehuʻi pe ngaahi fakahinohino, mo e meʻa pē ʻokú ke ʻoatu. Ko e ngaahi prompt mahino ange ʻoku faʻa maʻu ai ha ngaahi tali lelei ange.
gloss.prompteng.text: Ko e poto ʻo hono tohi e ngaahi prompt ʻoku maʻu ai ha ngaahi ola falalaʻanga mo ʻaonga.
gloss.sysprompt.text: Ko e ngaahi fakahinohino ʻi mui ʻoku maʻu ʻe ha AI kimuʻa pea kamata e talanoa, ʻoku fokotuʻu ai hono fatongia mo e ngaahi lao. ʻOku mamafa ange ia ʻi he meʻa ʻokú ke taipe.
gloss.context.text: Ko e meʻa kotoa ʻoku lava ʻe he AI ʻo sio ki ai lolotonga ʻene ngāue: ko e ngaahi fakahinohino, hoʻo ngaahi pōpoaki, ngaahi fail kuo ne lau mo e ngaahi tali kimuʻa.
gloss.ctxwin.text: Ko e lahi ʻoku lava ʻe ha AI ʻo tauhi ʻi hono fakakaukau ʻi he taimi tatau, ʻoku fua ʻaki e ngaahi token. Hili ia, ʻoku siʻaki pe fakanounou e ngaahi konga motuʻa.
gloss.session.text: Ko ha talanoa ngāue ʻe taha mo ha AI, mei he kamata ki he ʻosi. Ko e sēsini foʻou ʻoku kamata mo ha manatu foʻou.
gloss.memory.text: Ko e ngaahi nouti ʻoku tauhi ʻe ha AI ʻi he vahaʻa ʻo e ngaahi sēsini, ke manatuʻi hoʻo ngaahi fili mo e ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni kimuʻa.
gloss.hallucination.text: Ko e taimi ʻoku lea ai ha AI ʻi ha founga ʻoku ongo fakapapau ka ko ha meʻa kuo ngaohi pe hala. Sivi e ngaahi meʻa mahuʻinga.
gloss.training.text: Ko hono akoʻi ʻo ha mōtēle ʻaki hono fakahā kiate ia ha ngaahi sīpinga lahi fau, kimuʻa pea ngāueʻaki ia ʻe ha taha.
gloss.trainingdata.text: Ko e ngaahi sīpinga naʻe ako mei ai ha mōtēle. ʻOku ngata ʻene ʻilo ʻi he ʻaho naʻe tānaki ai e data ko ia.
gloss.cutoff.text: Ko e ʻaho ʻoku ngata ai e ʻilo ʻi loto ʻi ha AI. ʻE ʻikai ke ne ʻilo e ngaahi meʻa kimui ange kapau ʻoku ʻikai ke ne kumi ki ai.
gloss.finetune.text: Ko ha toe ako fakalahi ʻo ha mōtēle ʻoku ʻi ai ʻaki hoʻo ngaahi sīpinga ʻaʻau, ke lelei ange ia ki ha ngāue pau.
gloss.inference.text: Ko ha mōtēle AI ʻoku ngāueʻaki moʻoni ke tali ha meʻa, ʻo ʻikai ko hono akoʻi.
gloss.tooluse.text: Ko ha AI ʻoku lava ke fai ha ngaahi meʻa, ʻo ʻikai ko hono lea pē: lele ha ngaahi fekau, lau ha ngaahi fail pe kumi ʻi he uepi, ʻaki e ngaahi meʻangāue ʻoku foaki ʻe he app kiate ia.
gloss.subagent.text: Ko ha AI tokoni ʻoku foaki ki ai ʻe ha AI tefito ha ngāue siʻi ange, pea maʻu mei ai e ola.
gloss.multiagent.text: Ko ha ngaahi AI tokolahi ʻoku nau ngāue fakataha ki ha konga ngāue ʻe taha, taki taha mo hono konga, hangē ko ha timi siʻi.
gloss.autonomy.text: Ko e lahi ʻo e meʻa ʻe lava ʻe ha AI ʻo fai ʻiate ia pē kimuʻa pea totonu ke fehuʻi ki ha tokotaha.
gloss.hitl.text: Ko hono tauhi ʻo ha tokotaha ke kau ki ai ke vakaiʻi pe fakangofua e meʻa ʻoku fai ʻe he AI ʻi he ngaahi taimi mahuʻinga. ʻI he AI-gile ko koe ia.
gloss.guardrails.text: Ko e ngaahi ngataʻanga mo e ngaahi sivi ʻoku tauhi malu ai e ngaahi ngāue ʻa ha AI, hangē ko e fiemaʻu ʻo ha fakangofua kimuʻa pea hū ha meʻa ki he laine. ʻOku nau fakasiʻisiʻi e fakatuʻutāmaki ʻo e ngaahi hala, ka ʻoku ʻikai ke nau taʻofi kakato ia.
gloss.rag.text: Ko hono tuku ke kumi ha AI ʻi hoʻo ngaahi tohi ʻaʻau kimuʻa pea tali, ke makatuʻunga ʻene ngaahi tali ʻi hoʻo ngaahi fakamatala moʻoni.
gloss.embedding.text: Ko hono liliu e tohi ki ha lisi fika ʻoku maʻu ai ʻa hono ʻuhinga, ke lava ʻe ha komipiuta ʻo kumi ha ngaahi meʻa ʻoku ʻuhinga tatau.
gloss.vectordb.text: Ko ha database kuo langa ke kumi e ngaahi lisi fika ko ia (embeddings), ke maʻu ha ngaahi meʻa ʻoku ʻuhinga tatau.
gloss.mcp.text: Ko ha founga angamaheni ke fakafehokotaki e ngaahi meʻangāue mo e ngaahi tupuʻanga fakamatala ki he ngaahi app AI, ke lava ʻe ha AI ʻo ngāueʻaki ia.
gloss.temperature.text: Ko ha fokotuʻu ki he anga ʻo e toʻa ʻo e ngaahi tali ʻa ha AI. Ko e fokotuʻu mā lalo ʻoku ʻomi ai ha ngaahi tali tuʻumaʻu mo faingofua ange ke tomuʻa ʻilo; ko e māʻolunga ʻoku ʻomi ai ha ngaahi tali kehekehe ange. ʻOku ʻikai ha taha ʻo e ongo meʻa ni ʻe tonu maʻu pē ai.
gloss.multimodal.text: Lava ke ngāue mo e faʻahinga fakamatala lahi ange ʻi he taha, hangē ko e tohi, tā mo e leʻo.
gloss.evals.text: Ko ha sivi kuo palani ki he lelei ʻo ha AI ʻi ha ngaahi sīpinga kuo fili, ke lava ʻo fakahoa e ngaahi mōtēle pe prompt.
gloss.bias.text: Ko e taimi ʻoku filifilimānako taʻetotonu ai ha AI (pe ha tokotaha) ki ha tafaʻaki ʻe taha, ʻoku faʻa makatuʻunga ʻi he meʻa naʻá ne ako mei ai.
gloss.responsible.text: Ko hono ngāueʻaki ʻo e AI ʻi he anga totonu, malu mo faitotonu, pea kei fua pē ʻe he kakai e fatongia ʻo e ngaahi ola.
gloss.injection.text: Ko ha kākā ʻoku feinga ai ʻa e ngaahi fakahinohino fufū ʻi ha peesi uepi pe fail ke ngaohi ha AI ke fai ha meʻa naʻe ʻikai kole ʻe hono tokotaha ngāueʻaki.
gloss.ratelimit.text: Ko ha ngataʻanga ki he lahi ʻo e ngaahi kole te ke lava ʻo fekau ki ha sēvesi ʻi ha vahaʻa taimi kuo fokotuʻu. Kapau ʻokú ke laka ai, ʻoku totonu ke ke tatali.
gloss.usagelimit.text: Ko e lahi ʻo e ngāue AI ʻoku fakangofua ʻe hoʻo palani ʻi ha vahaʻa taimi, pea hili ia ʻoku tuʻu pe lahi ange e totongi.
gloss.vibe.text: Ko hono langa ha polokalama ʻaki hono fakamatala ki ha AI e meʻa ʻokú ke loto ki ai pea tuku ke ne tohi e koti.
gloss.budget.text: Ko e lahi ʻo e paʻanga kuo tuku ki ha meʻa.
gloss.costest.text: Ko ha fakafuofua lelei taha ki he fakamole ʻo ha meʻa kimuʻa pea ke kamata.
gloss.roi.text: Ko e meʻa ʻokú ke maʻu mai ʻo fakahoa mo e meʻa naʻá ke tuku ki ai. Kapau ʻoku lelei, naʻe ʻaonga.
gloss.tco.text: Ko e meʻa kotoa ʻoku fakamole moʻoni ha meʻa ʻi hono moʻui kakato, ʻo ʻikai ko e totongi fakatau pē: fakalele, tokoni, ngaahi fakafoʻou, pea mo hono fakangata ʻi he ngataʻanga.
gloss.capex.text: Ko e CapEx ko e paʻanga ʻoku fakamoleki ki muʻa ki he ngaahi meʻa ʻokú ke tauhi; ko e OpEx ko e fakamole hokohoko, hangē ko e ngaahi pili ʻo e mahina.
gloss.subscription.text: Ko hono totongi maʻu pē, ʻo faʻa ʻi he mahina pe taʻu taki taha, ke hokohoko hono ngāueʻaki ha meʻa.
gloss.saas.text: Ko e polokalama ʻokú ke ngāueʻaki ʻi he laine pea totongi ʻaki ha subscription, lolotonga ʻoku fakalele ia ʻe he tokotaha ngaohi maʻau.
gloss.payg.text: Ko hono totongi pē e meʻa ʻokú ke ngāueʻaki, hangē ko e cloud computing pe ko e ngaahi token AI.
gloss.overage.text: Ko e ngāueʻaki ʻoku laka ʻi he meʻa ʻoku kau ʻi hoʻo palani, ʻa ia ʻe ala fakamole lahi ange.
gloss.billingalert.text: Ko ha pōpoaki ʻi he taimi ʻoku aʻu ai e fakamole pe ngāueʻaki ki ha tuʻunga naʻá ke fili. ʻOku ne fakatokanga koe, ka ʻoku ʻikai taʻofi maʻu pē ai e ngaahi totongi hoko.
gloss.freetier.text: Ko ha tuʻunga taʻetotongi ʻo ha sēvesi totongi, mo e ngaahi ngataʻanga. ʻAonga ki he kamata.
gloss.pricing.text: Ko e ngaahi pēkesi kehekehe ʻoku faʻa fakatau ʻe ha sēvesi, taki taha mo hono totongi mo e ngaahi ngataʻanga.
gloss.licence.text: Ko e ngaahi lao ki he anga ʻo hoʻo ngāueʻaki, kopi, liliu pe vahevahe ha meʻa naʻe ngaohi ʻe ha taha kehe, hangē ko e polokalama, faʻahinga mataʻitohi pe tā.
gloss.opensource.text: Ko e polokalama ʻoku lava ʻe he tokotaha kotoa ʻo lau ʻene koti, ngāueʻaki mo faʻa liliu taʻetotongi, ʻi lalo ʻo e ngaahi lao ʻo ʻene laisensi.
gloss.osslicence.text: Ko e ngaahi lao ʻoku ʻi ai mo e koti open source. Ko e niʻihi ʻoku nau tuku koe ke fai ha meʻa pē (hangē ko e MIT); ko e niʻihi ʻoku nau kole ke vahevahe foki hoʻo ngaahi liliu (hangē ko e GPL).
gloss.proprietary.text: Ko e meʻa ʻoku ʻa ha timi pea ʻikai tauʻatāina ke kopi pe liliu. Ko e fakafepaki ia ʻo e open source.
gloss.copyright.text: Ko e totonu fakalao ʻa e tokotaha ngaohi ke pule ki he ngaahi kopi ʻo ʻene ngāue, kau ai e koti mo e tohi.
gloss.ip.text: Ko e ngaahi fakakaukau mo e ngaahi meʻa kuo ngaohi ʻoku lau ʻe he lao ko e meʻa ʻa ha taha, hangē ko e koti, tisaini, hingoa mo e fakaʻilonga.
gloss.tos.text: Ko e ngaahi lao ʻokú ke loto taha ki ai ʻi hoʻo ngāueʻaki ha sēvesi.
gloss.contract.text: Ko ha loto taha kuo tohi ʻi he vahaʻa ʻo e ongo tafaʻaki ʻoku poupouʻi ʻe he lao.
gloss.sow.text: Ko ha tohi ʻoku fokotuʻu ai e ngāue ʻe fai, ʻi he taimi fē, pea ko e hā hono totongi.
gloss.fixedprice.text: Ko ha totongi kuo loto taha ki ai ki he ngāue kakato, neongo pe ko e fuoloa fiha.
gloss.tm.text: Ko hono totongi ʻi he ngaahi houa naʻe ngāue moʻoni mo e ngaahi meʻa naʻe ngāueʻaki moʻoni, ʻo ʻikai ko ha totongi kuo fokotuʻu.
gloss.invoice.text: Ko ha pili ʻoku kole ai ha totongi ki he ngāue kuo fai pe ngaahi koloa kuo ʻoatu.
gloss.lockin.text: Ko e taimi ʻoku faingataʻa pe fakamole lahi fau ai hono hiki mei ha tokotaha ʻomi koloa ʻo ke tuʻu maʻu pē ai mo ia.
gloss.procurement.text: Ko e founga ʻo hono fili mo fakatau mei he ngaahi tokotaha ʻomi koloa.
gloss.servicecredit.text: Ko e paʻanga foki pe fakasiʻisiʻi totongi ʻokú ke maʻu ʻi he taimi ʻoku ʻikai fakahoko ai ʻe ha tokotaha ʻomi koloa ʻene SLA.
tour.firststeps.title: ʻUluaki ngaahi sitepu
tour.firststeps.text: Ko ha lisi nounou ke kamata ai: ngaohi ha poloseki, tānaki ha kaati, fakaafeʻi ha kaumeʻa. ʻE fakaʻilongaʻi pē ia ʻi hoʻo fai ia. Fufū ia ʻi hoʻo ʻilo ho hala.
tour.firststeps.short: Ko ha ngaahi meʻa siʻi ke fai ʻuluaki. ʻOku nau fakaʻilongaʻi pē kinautolu.
tour.firststeps.why: Ko hono fai tuʻo taha ʻo e meʻa takitaha ko e founga vave taha ia ke ako ai e laupapa.
tour.help.title: Tokoni ʻi hoʻo fiemaʻu
tour.help.text: ❓ ʻOku ʻi he Tokoni ʻa e Kamata, ko e takai ni ke toe fai, mo e 📖 fakahinohino, ʻa ia ʻoku ne fakamatalaʻi ʻa e ngaahi lea makehe ʻi ha lea faingofua. Ngaohi ha poloseki pe tānaki ha kaati ke kamata ai.
tour.help.short: ❓ Tokoni: Kamata, toe fai e takai mo e 📖 fakahinohino.
tour.chat.text.noai: Talanoa mo ho ngaahi kaumeʻa heni. Fakaava e talanoa ʻa ha kaumeʻa ke ke ui ai kiate ia, mo e vitiō mo e vahevahe sikilini.
tour.chat.short.noai: Ngaahi talanoa mo e kaumeʻa. Ui ki ha taha mei heʻene talanoa.
tour.chat.why.noai: Talanoaʻi e ngaahi meʻa ʻi he tafaʻaki pē ʻo e ngāue, ʻikai ha toe polokalama kehe.

claim.err.full: Kuo lahi ʻaupito hono vahevahe ʻo e tatau ni, ko ia ʻoku ʻikai ke ne lava ʻo tuku ha taha foʻou ke hū mai. Kole ki he tokotaha naʻa ne ʻoatu kiate koe ha fakaafe ʻaʻau pē.
