sample.svc.offers: Ko e peesi RSVP ʻoku tala ai ʻe he kau fakaafe pe te nau haʻu
sample.svc.users: Ko e kau fakaafe ʻe toko tolungofulu ki he pāti
sample.inc.t: Ako: ʻoku fakahā ʻe he peesi RSVP ha fehalaaki
sample.inc.d: Ko ha meʻa ngaohi pē, ke ako ai. Ko e kau fakaafe ʻoku nau fakaava ʻa e fehokotaki RSVP ʻoku nau sio ki he "Naʻe ʻi ai ha meʻa naʻe hala", ko ia ʻoku ʻikai lava ha taha ʻo tala te ne haʻu. Muimui ki he ngaahi sitepu 🎓 Sivi ia ʻi he kaati ni: ʻikai ha meʻa moʻoni ʻe maumau pea ʻikai ngāueʻaki ha AI.
sample.inc.say: Naʻe fekau mai ʻe he kau fakaafe ʻe toko tolu: talu mei he pongipongi ni ʻoku pehē ʻe he peesi RSVP "Naʻe ʻi ai ha meʻa naʻe hala".
sample.inc.major: 🚨 Ako: ko e meʻa fakatuʻupakē lahi eni he taimí ni. ʻI ha sēvesi moʻoni ʻoku kamata ʻa e ngāue fakataha, ʻoku ueʻi ʻa e ʻeiseniti ʻoku tokanga pea ʻoku ke maʻu ha fakatokanga ʻe taha. ʻI heni ʻoku ʻikai ueʻi ha taha. Hoko: fakatonutonu pea tāpuni ʻa e kaati.
sample.inc.pir: 📝 Ako: tohi koe pē ʻa e toe vakai hili ʻa e hoko, ʻi he foomu ʻi he kaati ni: ko e hokohoko, ko e meʻa naʻe tokoni mo e meʻa ke liliu.
sample.inc.rbgo: 📖 Ako: ʻi ha poloseki moʻoni ʻe tauhi he taimí ni ʻa e tohi ngāue ni ko e {file} ʻi he folta ʻo e poloseki. ʻOku ʻikai ha folta ʻa e sāmpale, ko ia naʻe ʻikai tohi ha meʻa.
gloss.ci.text: Ko ha meʻa ʻe taha ʻoku falala ki ai hoʻo sēvesi, hangē ko ha sēvā, ha tomeini, ha tohi fakamoʻoni, ha kī pe ha tokotaha ʻoku ne ʻomi ha meʻa. ʻOku hokohoko ʻe he 🗂️ Ngaahi meʻa fokotuʻu ʻa kinautolu ʻo fakatatau ki he sēvesi, koeʻuhi ke ke sio ki he meʻa ʻoku uesia ʻe ha meʻa fakatuʻupakē mo e meʻa ʻoku fiemaʻu ke fakafoʻou pe tauhi ha kopi maluʻi.
gloss.expiry.text: Ko e ʻaho ʻoku ʻosi ai ha meʻa ke ngāue kapau ʻoku ʻikai fakafoʻou, hangē ko e tohi fakamoʻoni malu ʻo ha uepisaiti pe tuʻasila uepi. ʻOku tokanga ʻa AI-gile ki he ngaahi ʻaho ni pea ngaohi ha kaati ʻe taha ke fakafoʻou taki taha ʻi he ʻaho ʻe 30 kimuʻa, ke ʻoua naʻa ʻosi ha meʻa fakafokifā.
gloss.desk.text: Ko e potu ʻoku haʻu ki ai ʻa e ngaahi fehuʻi mo e lipooti mei he kakai ʻoku nau ngāueʻaki hoʻo sēvesi. ʻOku vaheʻi ʻe AI-gile ʻa e taha kotoa ko ha kole, ha meʻa fakatuʻupakē pe ha fakakaukau, pea ʻoku ne tala atu kapau ʻoku hangē ia ha meʻa kuo ʻosi lipooti.
gloss.svcrequest.text: Ko ha taha ʻoku ne kole ha meʻa angamaheni, hangē ko ha ʻakauni foʻou pe kiʻi tokoni, kae ʻikai ko hano lipooti ʻoku maumau ha meʻa. ʻOku tatali ia ki hono taimi; ʻoku ʻuluaki ʻa e meʻa fakatuʻupakē.
gloss.svcreview.also: toe vakai ʻo e māhina,service review
gloss.svcreview.text: Ko ha sio ki mui ki he māhina ʻe taha ʻo ha sēvesi: ko e ngaahi meʻa fakatuʻupakē naʻe fakaava mo fakatonutonu, ko e vave ʻo e maʻu ʻe he kakai ha tali, ko e taimi naʻe ngāue ai mo e ngaahi token naʻe ngāueʻaki. ʻOku fakahā ʻe he Toe vakai ʻo e māhina ʻeni ki he sēvesi taki taha.
gloss.accessreview.also: ngaahi sivi ʻo e hū,access review
gloss.accessreview.text: Ko hono sivi ʻi he ʻaho ʻe 90 kotoa pē ko hai ʻoku kei lava ʻo hū mai: ko e ngaahi fehokotaki vahevahe, ngaahi fatongia ʻo e kaumeʻa mo e ngaahi lea fakaʻilonga mo e kī kuo tauhi. ʻOkú ke tauhi pe toʻo e taha kotoa, ke ʻoua naʻa kei tuʻu e hū motuʻa.
gloss.improvements.text: Ko e meʻa kotoa pē naʻe fili ʻe he timi ke fakalelei, ʻi ha potu pē ʻe taha: ko e ngaahi fokotuʻu mei he toe vakai, ko e ngaahi ngāue mei he ngaahi sivi mo e ngaahi fakatonutonu ʻo e palopalema, taki taha mo hono tuʻunga. Kumi ia ʻi he 📈 Ngaahi fakalelei.
gloss.tokencap.text: Ko ha ngataʻanga ʻi he māhina ki he ngaahi token ʻe lava ke ngāueʻaki ʻe he ngaahi ʻeiseniti ʻo ha sēvesi. ʻI he 80% ʻoku ke maʻu ha fakatokanga; ʻi he 100% ʻoku tatali ʻenau ngāue ʻi mui ki he māhina hoko pe kae ʻoua ke ke hiki ʻa e ngataʻanga.
dc.setup.intro: Talanoa mo ha ʻeiseniti mei he Discord, faingofua tatau pē mo e laupapa. ʻIkai fiemaʻu.
dc.guide.1.html: ʻAlu ki he discord.com/developers/applications pea kiliki ʻi he New Application. Fakahingoa ia ʻaki ʻa e hingoa ʻo e ʻeiseniti.
dc.guide.2.html: Fakaava ʻa e Bot ʻi he menu toʻohema, pea Reset Token pea kopi ia. ʻOku fakahā tuʻo taha pē.
dc.guide.3.html: Kei ʻi he Bot: ʻikai ha toe meʻa ke fakaʻā. ʻOku ʻikai fiemaʻu ʻe he ngaahi fakamatala hangatonu ha ngofua makehe.
dc.guide.4.html: Pēsiti ʻa e token ʻi lalo, fili pe ko hai ʻe talanoa ki ai ʻa e bot pea lomi ʻa e Tauhi.
dc.guide.5.html: Tānaki ʻa e bot ki ha server ʻoku ke ʻi ai: hili hono tauhi, lomi ʻa e 1. Tānaki ʻa e bot ki hoʻo server (ʻe lava pē ke fekau ha fakamatala ki ha bot kapau ʻoku mo ʻi he server tatau).
dc.guide.6.html: Lomi ʻa e Fehokotaki hoku Discord, pea ʻi he server ko ia kiliki ʻi he bot ʻi he lisi ʻo e kau mēmipa, fili ʻa e Message pea fekau ki ai ʻa e kouti. (ʻIkai fiemaʻu ha kouti kapau ʻoku ke fie pēsiti hoʻo User ID: Discord Settings > Advanced, Developer Mode, kiliki toʻomataʻu ʻi ho hingoa, Copy User ID.)

prac.h: 🎓 Sivi ia: tokangaʻi ʻa e meʻa fakatuʻupakē ni
prac.intro: Sitepu ʻe fā, kotoa ʻi he kaati ni. ʻOku fakaʻilongaʻi pē ʻe ia ʻa e taha kotoa ʻo ka ʻosi. ʻIkai ha AI, ʻikai ha meʻa moʻoni ʻe maumau.
prac.major.hint: ʻOku ʻikai lava ha fakaafe ʻo tala te ne haʻu, ko ia ʻoku uesia ai ʻa e tokotaha kotoa ʻoku ngāueʻaki ʻa e sēvesi: ʻoku ʻai ai ia ko ha meʻa fakatuʻupakē lahi. Kiliki ʻi he 🚨 Lahi ʻi he kaati ni. ʻI ha sēvesi moʻoni ʻoku ne ueʻi ʻa e ʻeiseniti ʻoku tokanga.
prac.close.hint: Pehē kuo ke maʻu ʻa e ʻuhinga: ko e fakafoʻou ʻanepō naʻe mole ai ʻa e pasiueti ʻo e database ʻo e foomu. Ko hono toe ʻai ia ko e fakatonutonu ia (ko ha founga vave ke hao ai ʻo aʻu ki ai ko ha founga fakataimi ia). Ko eni ʻave ʻa e kaati ki he Kuo fai (⋯ ʻAve ki he) pea tali ʻa e ngaahi fehuʻi ʻe tolu ʻo e post-mortem.
prac.nomajor: Naʻe tāpuni kimuʻa pea fakaʻilongaʻi ko e Lahi, ko ia ʻoku ʻikai ha toe vakai ke tohi. Kiliki ʻi he ↩ Toe fakaava, lomi ʻa e 🚨 Lahi, pea toe tāpuni.
prac.review: Tohi ʻa e toe vakai hili ʻa e hoko
prac.review.hint: ʻOku maʻu ʻe ha meʻa fakatuʻupakē lahi ha toe vakai ʻoku ʻikai tukuakiʻi ai ha taha: ko e hā naʻe hoko mo e taimi fē, ko e hā naʻe tokoni, pea ko e hā ke liliu koeʻuhi ke ʻoua naʻa toe hoko (ko e tupuʻanga). Fakafonu ʻa e foomu ʻi he puha 📝 Toe vakai hili ʻa e hoko pea kiliki ʻi he Tuku atu ʻa e toe vakai.

guide.inc.hi:
- Ko ha **meʻa fakatuʻupakē** 🔥 ko ha kaati ia ki he "kuo maumau he taimí ni". ʻOku puna ki muʻa ʻi he laine pea ʻoku kulokula hono kapa.
- ʻI hono tāpuni ʻoku ne ʻeke ha fehuʻi nounou ʻe tolu: ko e hā naʻe hoko, ʻuhinga, ko e hā ʻoku mau liliu.
- Kapau ʻoku toe maumau ʻa e meʻa tatau, fakatahaʻi ʻa e ngaahi meʻa fakatuʻupakē ʻi lalo ʻi ha **palopalema** 🧩 ʻe taha mo hono tupuʻanga mo ha founga fakataimi.
- ʻOku ʻalu ʻa e fakatonutonu moʻoni ʻi ha kole liliu.
guide.inc.steps:
1. Fakahā ʻa e meʻa fakatuʻupakē: **Kaati foʻou**, faʻahinga **🔥 meʻa fakatuʻupakē**.
2. ʻUluaki fakatonutonu ia. Ngāueʻaki ʻa e founga fakataimi kapau ʻoku ʻi ai ha meʻa pehē ʻi he kaati palopalema.
3. ʻAve ia ki he kuo fai. Fakafonu ʻa e **Ko e hā naʻe hoko**, **ʻUhinga**, **Ko e hā ʻoku mau liliu**, pea **Kuo fai**.
4. Kuo hoko kimuʻa? Kole ki hoʻo taki ke ne fakatahaʻi ʻa e ngaahi meʻa fakatuʻupakē ʻi lalo ʻi ha kaati **🧩 palopalema** (ʻoku ʻi he *Maʻa e ngaahi ʻeiseniti* ʻa e ngaahi fekau).
5. ʻOku fakahā ʻe he kaati palopalema ʻa e **Tupuʻanga**, **Founga fakataimi**, ʻa e ngaahi meʻa fakatuʻupakē mo e kole liliu.
6. ʻOku kau ʻa e ngaahi meʻa fakatuʻupakē ʻamui ki he palopalema tatau; ʻoku hokohoko kotoa ia ʻe he kaati.
7. Fakahū ha kole liliu ki he fakatonutonu. ʻOku kei ava ʻa e palopalema kae ʻoua ke ʻosi ʻa e liliu ko ia.
guide.inc.full:
- **Ko e hā ʻoku mahuʻinga ai:** ko e meʻa fakatuʻupakē ʻoku fekauʻaki mo hono toe foki vave ki he angamaheni. Ko e palopalema ʻoku fekauʻaki mo e ʻuhinga. Kapau ʻoku ke fakafefiokaʻi, te ke tamateʻi ʻa e afi tatau ʻo toe pea toe.
- **Meʻa fakatuʻupakē:** ʻoku ʻikai tukuakiʻi ʻe he post-mortem ha taha. ʻOku ne tala ʻa e meʻa naʻe hoko, ʻuhinga, mo e meʻa ʻe liliu koeʻuhi ke ʻoua naʻa toe hoko. Ko ha fakatuʻutāmaki mei he lisi fakatuʻutāmaki ʻoku hoko moʻoni ʻoku ne fakaava ha meʻa fakatuʻupakē maʻau.
- **Palopalema:** ʻuhinga ʻe taha, meʻa fakatuʻupakē lahi. Ko e tupuʻanga ko e ʻuhinga ʻi mui ʻi he ʻuhinga (ʻikai ko e "naʻe mate ʻa e sēvā" ka ko e "ʻoku ʻikai fai ʻe he sikilipi deploy ʻa e ngaahi sivi"). Ko e founga fakataimi ko e meʻa ʻe lava ke fai ʻe ha taha kae ʻoua ke tuku atu ʻa e fakatonutonu.
- **Fehokotaki:** ʻoku ʻa ha palopalema pē ʻe taha ha meʻa fakatuʻupakē. ʻOku hā ʻa e fehokotaki ʻi he ongo kaati. Kapau te ke fehokotaki ia ki ha palopalema kehe, ʻe hiki ia ki ai.
- **Kole liliu:** ko e fakatonutonu ko ha liliu ia hangē ko e toenga, mo hano ʻuhinga, ha fakatuʻutāmaki mo ha hala ke foki ai. ʻOku kei ava ʻa e palopalema kae ʻoua ke ʻosi ʻa e liliu ko ia.
- **Ngaahi angaʻitangata lelei:** sio ki he ngaahi palopalema ava ʻi he toe vakai kotoa pē; kapau ʻoku tatau ʻa e ʻuhinga ʻo e meʻa fakatuʻupakē ʻe tolu, faʻu ʻa e palopalema; tauhi ke nounou ʻa e ngaahi founga fakataimi ke lava ʻo muimui ki ai neongo ʻoku mafasia.
guide.inc.agents:
- Fakahā ha meʻa fakatuʻupakē: `aigile add <proj> "Site is down" --type incident`
- Faʻu ha palopalema: `aigile problem <proj> add "Deploys break the site" --incidents AIG-1,AIG-2`
- ʻUhinga mo e founga fakataimi: `aigile problem <proj> AIG-9 --cause "..." --workaround "..."`
- Fehokotaki ha meʻa fakatuʻupakē ʻamui: `aigile problem <proj> AIG-9 link AIG-12`
- Fehokotaki ʻa e kole liliu: `aigile problem <proj> AIG-9 --change AIG-20`
guide.svc.hi:
- Tala ki he laupapa pe ko e fē ngaahi poloseki ko e **sēvesi**: ko e hā ʻoku nau ʻomi, ko hai ʻoku ngāueʻaki, mo honau ʻadresi initaneti. Pea ʻe leʻohi ʻe he laupapa ʻa e ʻadresi maʻau.
- ʻI he taimi ʻoku tuku ai ʻe ha sēvesi ʻa e tali, ʻoku fakaava pē ʻe he laupapa ha **meʻa fakatuʻupakē ʻe taha**. Ko ha kaati ʻoku tatali fuoloa ʻoku ne fakahā ha uasi kulokula ⏰ "tali kimuʻa ʻi he".
- Ko ha meʻa fakatuʻupakē kovi moʻoni ʻoku maʻu ʻa e pātone **🚨 Lahi**: ko e kiliki pē ʻe taha ʻoku ne ueʻi ʻa e ʻeiseniti totonu pea tala atu kiate koe. Ko ha peesi tuʻunga ki he kakai kotoa ʻoku ne fakahā ki he kaumeʻa ʻa e meʻa ʻoku hoko.
- ʻOku tauhi ʻa e meʻa ʻoku ke ako: **🧩 Ngaahi hala ʻoku ʻiloa**, **📖 Ngaahi tohi ngāue** (founga ke fakatonutonu ai ʻa e X) mo ha **📝 Toe vakai hili ʻa e hoko** ki he meʻa fakatuʻupakē lahi taki taha.
- Tokanga ki he **🗂️ Ngaahi meʻa** ʻoku tuʻu ai hoʻo sēvesi (ngaahi ʻaho ʻosiʻanga, kopi maluʻi), ko e **🔐 Sivi ʻo e hū** ʻi he ʻaho ʻe 90 kotoa pē, **🚀 Ngaahi tukuange**, ko e lisi **📈 Ngaahi fakalelei** pea, tuʻo taha ʻi he māhina, ko e **📆 Toe vakai** (mo ha ngataʻanga token ʻi he māhina kapau ʻoku ke loto ki ai).
guide.svc.steps:
1. ʻI he laupapa ʻo e poloseki kiliki ʻi he **🎨 Fōtunga**. ʻI he matapā **Ngaahi fokotuʻu ʻo e poloseki** kumi ʻa e konga **🛎️ Sēvesi**. Fakaʻilongaʻi ʻa e **Ko e poloseki ni ko ha sēvesi** pea fakafonu ʻa e meʻa ʻoku ne ʻomi, ko hai ʻoku ngāueʻaki mo hono ʻadresi initaneti.
2. Fili ʻa e **ʻEiseniti ʻoku tokanga** (ko e taki ʻi he angamaheni) pea fakaʻilongaʻi ʻa e **Ki he kakai kotoa** kapau ʻe lava ke sio ki ai ʻa e kaumeʻa ʻi he peesi tuʻunga. Kapau ʻoku ke loto, taipe ha **Ngataʻanga token ʻo e māhina** koeʻuhi ke ʻoua naʻa kai ʻe ha poloseki ʻe taha ʻa e pāseti kotoa. Kiliki ʻi he **Tauhi**.
3. Sio ki he poini ʻo e poloseki ʻi he **ʻApi**: ko e lanu mata ʻoku tali ʻa e ʻadresi. Kapau ʻoku tuku ʻene tali, ʻe hā pē ha kaati meʻa fakatuʻupakē.
4. Fakaava ʻa e kaati meʻa fakatuʻupakē ko ia. ʻOku kovi? Kiliki ʻi he **🚨 Lahi**. Kiliki ʻi he **Fakaʻosi ʻa e hoko fakafokifā lahi** ʻo ka ʻosi.
5. Ko e ngaahi kaati ʻoku tatali fuoloa ʻoku nau fakahā ha ⏰ kulokula. ʻUluaki fakaava ʻa kinautolu. Ko e sivi ʻo e puha tohi **Tesi: ngaahi meʻa fakatuʻupakē** ʻoku ne fakahā pē ʻa e ngaahi meʻa fakatuʻupakē mei he kaumeʻa mo e foomu fakakaukau.
6. Kiliki ʻi he **⋯ Toe** ʻi he laupapa, pea **🗂️ Ngaahi meʻa**. Kiliki ʻi he **+ Tānaki ha meʻa** ki he sēvā, tomeini, tohi fakamoʻoni, kī, repo pe tokotaha ʻomi taki taha. Tānaki ha ʻaho ʻosiʻanga pea, ki he fakamatala, ko e fē ʻoku tauhi ai hono kopi maluʻi mo e tuʻo fiha. Kiliki ʻi he **Kuo tauhi ʻi he ʻaho ni** hili ʻa e kopi maluʻi kotoa pē.
7. ʻI ha kaati meʻa fakatuʻupakē, sio ki he puha **📖 Ngaahi tohi ngāue**: ʻoku ne hokohoko ʻa e ngaahi fakahinohino ʻoku hoa. Kiliki ʻi he **Fakaava** ke lau ha taha.
8. Hili hano ʻosi ʻo ha meʻa fakatuʻupakē lahi, ʻoku fakahā ʻe hono kaati ʻa e **📝 Toe vakai hili ʻa e hoko**. Lau ʻa e hokohoko, pea kiliki ʻi he **Faʻu ha kaati** ʻi he tafaʻaki ʻo e meʻa kotoa ʻoku taau ke liliu.
9. Kiliki ʻi he **⋯ Toe**, pea **🧩 Ngaahi hala ʻoku ʻiloa** ke sio ki he ngaahi palopalema ʻoku ʻi ai ha founga fakataimi. Kiliki ʻi he **🚀 Ngaahi tukuange**, taipe ha hingoa hangē ko e v1.3 pea kiliki ʻi he **🚀 Tukuange foʻou** ke tānaki ʻa e ngaahi kaati kuo fai ki ha ngaahi nouti. ʻOku fakaava ʻe he **↩ Toe foki** ha kaati lisi ke toe fakafoki ai.
10. Tuʻo taha ʻi he māhina kiliki ʻi he **⋯ Toe**, pea **📆 Toe vakai**: ngāueʻaki ʻa e **← Kimuʻa** mo e **ʻAmui →** ke liliu ʻa e māhina, mo e **✍️ Fakamatala nounou** ki ha fakamatala laine ʻe ua mei he ʻeiseniti ʻoku tokanga.
11. Kiliki ʻi he **⋯ Toe**, pea **📈 Ngaahi fakalelei** (ʻoku ʻi he menu **❓ Tokoni** foki) ke sio ki he ngaahi fakakaukau mei he toe vakai, ngaahi ngāue mei he sivi mo e ngaahi fakatonutonu palopalema ʻi ha lisi pē ʻe taha. ʻI he **Fokotuʻu**, kiliki ʻi he **Fai ʻa e sivi ʻo e hū he taimi ni** ke sio pe ko hai ʻoku lava ʻo hū, pea **Tauhi** pe **Toʻo** ʻa e taha kotoa.
guide.svc.full:
- **Ngaahi fakaikiiki ʻo e sēvesi:** ʻi he **🎨 Fōtunga**, **Ngaahi fokotuʻu ʻo e poloseki**, **🛎️ Sēvesi** ʻoku ke tala ʻa e meʻa ʻoku ʻomi ʻe ha poloseki, ki hai, ʻi he ʻadresi initaneti fē mo hai ʻoku tokanga. Ko e ngaahi poloseki pē ʻoku ke fakaʻilongaʻi ʻoku lau ko e sēvesi.
- **Poini ngāue:** ʻi he miniti siʻi kotoa pē ʻoku ʻeke ʻe he laupapa ki he ʻadresi initaneti pe ʻoku kei moʻui. Ko e lanu mata ʻoku sai; ko e kulokula naʻe ʻikai tali. Ko e tō ʻe tolu hokohoko ʻoku ne fakaava ha meʻa fakatuʻupakē ʻe taha, ʻikai ha fuʻu tānaki, pea ʻoku tala ʻe ha fakamatala ʻa e taimi naʻe toe foki mai ai ("Kuo toe moʻui hili ʻa e miniti N").
- **Tali kimuʻa ʻi he ⏰:** ʻoku ʻi ai ha taimi tali ki he faʻahinga kaati taki taha (ko ha meʻa fakatuʻupakē ko e houa nai ʻe taha, ko ha kole ʻa ha kaumeʻa ko e ʻaho siʻi, ko ha bug ko e uike nai ʻe taha). ʻOku hoko ʻo kulokula ʻa e ngaahi kaati tōmui pea ʻoku hokohoko ia ʻe he fakamatala ʻo e ʻaho. Ko e ngaahi taumuʻa eni, ʻikai ko ha ngaahi talaʻofa.
- **🚨 Lahi:** ki ha meʻa fakatuʻupakē ʻoku uesia ai ʻa e kau ngāueʻaki tokolahi pe fakatuʻutāmakiʻi ʻa e paʻanga pe fakamatala. Ko e kiliki pē ʻe taha ʻoku ne kamata ʻa e ngāue fakataha, ueʻi ʻa e ʻeiseniti ʻoku tokanga, fekau atu ha fakatokanga ʻe taha pea kole ha fakamatala "Tuʻunga:" ʻi he miniti ʻe 30 kotoa pē.
- **Peesi tuʻunga:** ʻoku fakahā ʻe ha peesi ki he kakai kotoa ʻa e sēvesi ki he kakai kotoa taki taha ko e lanu mata, lanu moli pe kulokula mo e laine tuʻunga fakamuimui. ʻOku ʻikai teitei fakahā ʻa e tohi ʻo e kaati, ko e laine pē naʻá ke fili pe naʻe fili ʻe he ʻeiseniti.
- **Tesi sēvesi:** ʻoku vaheʻi ʻa e ngaahi lipooti mei he kaumeʻa mo e foomu fakakaukau ko e **Kole**, **Meʻa fakatuʻupakē** pe **Fakakaukau**. ʻOku fakahā ʻe he sivi ʻo e puha tohi (**Tesi: kotoa**, **Tesi: ngaahi kole** mo e alā meʻa) ha faʻahinga ʻe taha. Ko ha lipooti ʻoku hangē ha kaati ʻoku ʻosi ʻiate koe ʻoku ne pehē "ʻoku hangē ko AIG-12" mo ha pātone **Fehokotaki**.
- **🧩 Ngaahi hala ʻoku ʻiloa:** ko ha palopalema ʻoku ʻiloa hono ʻuhinga pea ʻi ai ha founga fakataimi ka ʻoku teʻeki ʻosi. ʻOku hokohoko ia ki he poloseki taki taha mo e ngaahi poloseki kotoa, pea ʻoku hū ki he fakamatala ʻa e ʻeiseniti kotoa pē, koeʻuhi ke ʻoua naʻa fakatotolo ha taha tuʻo ua.
- **📖 Ngaahi tohi ngāue:** ko e ngaahi fakahinohino nounou sitepu ki he sitepu ki he founga ke fakatonutonu ai ha meʻa. ʻOku fakahā ʻe ha kaati meʻa fakatuʻupakē ʻa e ngaahi meʻa ʻoku hoa mo hono kaveinga. Hili ha toe vakai, ʻe lava ʻe he ʻeiseniti ʻo fokotuʻu ha tohi ngāue foʻou pea ʻoku ke pehē Fai pe Teʻeki.
- **📝 Toe vakai hili ʻa e hoko:** hili hano ʻosi ʻo ha meʻa fakatuʻupakē lahi, ʻoku tohi ʻe he ʻeiseniti ha **Hokohoko**, **Ko e meʻa naʻe tokoni** mo e **Ko e meʻa ke liliu**. ʻOku hoko ʻa e ngāue taki taha ko ha kaati ʻaki ʻa e **Faʻu ha kaati**. Kapau ʻoku ʻikai ha ʻeiseniti ʻatā, ʻoku ke tohi koe.
- **🗂️ Ngaahi meʻa:** ko e lisi ʻo e ngaahi meʻa ʻoku tuʻu ai ha sēvesi, mo ha **Faʻahinga** (sēvā, tomeini, tohi fakamoʻoni, kī, repo, tokotaha ʻomi, kehe). ʻE lava ke ʻi ai ha ngaahi fehokotaki ki he ngaahi kaati pe ʻadresi initaneti. Ko ha kī ko hono hingoa pē ʻi he Ngaahi fakafufū, ʻikai teitei ko e kī tonu. ʻE lava ke fakahā ʻe he ngaahi kaati meʻa fakatuʻupakē mo e liliu ʻa e meʻa ʻoku nau **ʻOku uesia**.
- **ʻOsiʻanga mo e kopi maluʻi:** ʻi he ʻaho kotoa pē ʻoku sivi ʻe he laupapa ʻa e ngaahi ʻaho ʻosiʻanga mo e motuʻa ʻo e kopi maluʻi. ʻOku hā ha kaati kimuʻa pea ʻosi ha meʻa pe ʻi he taimi ʻoku fuʻu motuʻa ai ha kopi maluʻi, pea tuʻo taha ʻi he māhina ʻoku fakamanatu atu ʻe ha kaati sivi toe fakafoki ko ha kopi maluʻi naʻe ʻikai te ke feinga ke toe fakafoki ko ha ʻamanaki pē ia.
- **Moʻui lelei ʻo e sēvā:** ʻoku leʻohi ʻe he laupapa ʻa e CPU, manatu mo e tisi ʻi hoʻo ngaahi sēvā pea fakaava ha kaati fakalakalaka kimuʻa pea nau fonu.
- **🔐 Sivi ʻo e hū:** ʻi he ʻaho ʻe 90 kotoa pē ʻoku hokohoko ʻe ha kaati ʻe taha ʻa e ngaahi fehokotaki vahevahe, ngaahi fatongia ʻo e kaumeʻa mo e ngaahi fakafufū kuo tauhi (ngaahi hingoa pē), taki taha mo e **Tauhi** pe **Toʻo**. Fai ia he taimí ni mei he **Fokotuʻu**.
- **🚀 Ngaahi tukuange:** ko ha tukuange ko ha fuʻu kaati kuo fakahingoa ʻa ia kuo ʻosi talu mei he tukuange fakamuimui, mo ha ngaahi nouti nounou. ʻOku fakaava ʻe he **↩ Toe foki** ha kaati lisi mo e ngaahi sitepu ke toe fakafoki ai.
- **📈 Ngaahi fakalelei:** ko e ngaahi fokotuʻu mei he toe vakai, ngaahi ngāue mei he sivi mo e ngaahi fakatonutonu palopalema ʻi ha lisi pē ʻe taha, ʻe lava ke sivi ʻo fakatatau ki he poloseki, koeʻuhi ke ʻoua naʻa mole ʻa e ngaahi fakakaukau lelei ʻi he vahaʻa ʻo e ngaahi toe vakai.
- **📆 Toe vakai ʻo e māhina:** peesi ʻe taha ki he sēvesi taki taha ki he māhina ʻe taha: ko e ngaahi meʻa fakatuʻupakē naʻe fakaava mo tāpuni, taimi fakaʻavalisi ke fakatonutonu, ngaahi kaati naʻe aʻu ki honau taimi tali, taimi ngāue, ngaahi token naʻe ngāueʻaki mo e ngaahi tumutumu ʻo e sēvā. Fakaava ia mei he **⋯ Toe → 📆 Toe vakai** pe mei he **Ngaahi fokotuʻu ʻo e poloseki → Sēvesi**.
- **Ngataʻanga token ʻo e māhina:** ʻi he **Ngaahi fokotuʻu ʻo e poloseki → Sēvesi** ʻe lava ke ke fokotuʻu ha ngataʻanga token ʻi he māhina. ʻI he 80% ʻoku fakatokanga atu ʻe he fakamatala ʻo e ʻaho; ʻi he 100% ʻoku tatali ʻa e ngaahi ngāue ʻi mui ʻo e poloseki ko ia ki he māhina hoko pe kae ʻoua ke ke hiki ʻa e ngataʻanga. ʻOku kei ngāue pē hoʻo ueʻi koe ʻa e timi (▶ Ueʻi e timi).
- **Ngaahi angaʻitangata lelei:** ʻuluaki fakafonu ʻa e ngaahi fakaikiiki ʻo e sēvesi, tauhi ke totonu ʻa e ʻadresi initaneti, sio ki he poini tuʻunga ʻi he ʻaho kotoa pē, tohi ha toe vakai ki he meʻa fakatuʻupakē lahi kotoa pē, sivi ʻa e lisi fakalelei hili ʻa e toe vakai kotoa pē pea lau ʻa e toe vakai ʻo e māhina lolotonga ʻoku kei foʻou ʻa e māhina.
guide.svc.agents:
- Fakahā ha meʻa fakatuʻupakē: `aigile add <proj> "Site is down" --type incident`
- ʻUhinga ʻo e palopalema mo e founga fakataimi: `aigile problem <proj> AIG-9 --cause "..." --workaround "..."`
- Ngaahi meʻa fokotuʻu: `aigile ci <proj>` ʻoku ne hokohoko; `aigile ci <proj> add <kind> <name>` ʻoku ne tānaki ha taha
- Ngaahi tohi ngāue: `aigile runbook <proj>` ʻoku ne hokohoko; `aigile runbook <proj> <name>` ʻoku ne paaki ha taha
- Meʻa fakatuʻupakē lahi (tokotaha ʻoku ʻaʻana pe taki): `aigile major <proj> <incident id> --as NAME`; toe fai ke fakaʻosi
- Toe vakai hili ʻa e hoko: `aigile pir <proj> <incident id> --timeline ".." --helped ".." --actions "one | two" --as NAME`
- Tohi ngāue mei ha toe vakai: `aigile pir-runbook <proj> <incident id> <name> --text ".." --as NAME`
- Ngaahi tukuange: `aigile release <proj>` ʻoku ne hokohoko; `aigile release <proj> <name> --as NAME` ʻoku ne faʻu ha taha; tānaki ʻa e `rollback` ke toe fakafoki
guide.msg.hi:
- Ko e **💬 Ngaahi fakamatala**, ʻi ʻolunga ʻi he laine toʻohema, ʻoku ʻi ai hoʻo ngaahi talanoa kotoa: ngaahi taki poloseki, kaumeʻa, ngaahi kulupu ʻeiseniti mo e potu fakataha ʻo e poloseki taki taha. ʻOku fakahā ʻe he ngaahi sivi **🤖 Ngaahi ʻeiseniti**, **🙋 Kakai** mo e **🎥 Ngaahi potu fakataha** ha faʻahinga ʻe taha.
- Ko ha **DM** ko ha talanoa fakafoʻituitui mo ha taki ʻe taha pe ha kaumeʻa ʻe taha. Ko e ngaahi talanoa mo e kaumeʻa ʻoku fakapuliki ʻi he hala pea ʻi he komipiuta ni.
- Ko ha **kulupu** ʻoku ne ʻai ha ʻeiseniti ʻe ua pe lahi ange ki ha talanoa ʻe taha: tohi tuʻo taha pea ʻoku tali ʻe he taha kotoa.
- ʻI he talanoa mo ha kaumeʻa, ʻoku kamata ʻe he **📞 Fetuʻutaki** ha ui leʻo pe vitiō, mo e **🖥️ Vahevahe ʻa e sikilini**. ʻOku ʻi ai ʻa e **🎥 Hū ki he fetuʻutaki** ʻaʻana ʻi he potu fakataha ʻo e poloseki taki taha.
- Kuo poloka ʻa e maika pe kāmera? Fakaʻatā ia ʻi he laine ʻadresi ʻo e palausa. ʻE lava pē ke ke fanongo maʻu ai pē.
guide.msg.steps:
1. Kiliki ʻi he **💬 Ngaahi fakamatala** ʻi ʻolunga ʻi he laine toʻohema. Fili ha sivi ke sio pē ki he **🤖 Ngaahi ʻeiseniti**, **🙋 Kakai** pe **🎥 Ngaahi potu fakataha**.
2. Kiliki ʻi he taki ʻo ha poloseki ke talanoa hangatonu mo e timi ko ia. Taipe pea lomi ʻa e Enter; ʻoku tali ʻe he taki ʻi he talanoa tatau.
3. Kiliki ʻi ha kaumeʻa ʻi lalo ʻi he **🙋 Kakai** ke talanoa mo ia. ʻOku hā mai ha kaumeʻa ʻi heni hili ʻene hū mai ʻaki hoʻo fakaafe.
4. Ke ʻeke ki ha ʻeiseniti lahi ʻi he taimi tatau, kiliki ʻi he **＋ Kulupu foʻou**, ʻoange hano hingoa, fakaʻilongaʻi ha ʻeiseniti ʻe ua pe lahi ange pea kiliki ʻi he **Faʻu**.
5. ʻI he talanoa mo ha kaumeʻa kiliki ʻi he **📞 Fetuʻutaki**. ʻOku sio hoʻo kaumeʻa ʻoku ke ui pea kiliki ke hū. Ngāueʻaki ʻa e **🔇 Fakalongolongo**, **📷 Kāmera ʻā** mo e **🖥️ Vahevahe ʻa e sikilini**, pea **Mavahe mei he fetuʻutaki** ʻo ka ʻosi.
6. ʻI lalo ʻi he **🎥 Ngaahi potu fakataha**, fakaava ʻa e potu ʻo ha poloseki ke talanoa mo ʻene timi kotoa ʻi ha talanoa ʻe taha. Kiliki ʻi he **🎥 Hū ki he fetuʻutaki** ki hono ui leʻo pe vitiō.
7. ʻI he ʻuluaki taimi ʻoku kole ʻe he palausa ʻa e maika: kiliki ʻi he **Fakaʻatā**. Naʻá ke pehē ʻikai ʻi he fehalaaki? Kiliki ʻi he ʻaikoni ʻi he kamataʻanga ʻo e laine ʻadresi, fakaʻatā ʻa e maika pea toe ui.
guide.msg.full:
- **Potu pē ʻe taha ki he talanoa kotoa:** ʻoku hokohoko fakataha ʻe he **💬 Ngaahi fakamatala** ʻa e ngaahi taki, kaumeʻa, kulupu mo e ngaahi potu fakataha, ko e foʻou taha ʻi ʻolunga. ʻOku liliu pē ʻe he ngaahi sivi ʻa e meʻa ʻoku ke sio ai; ʻoku ʻikai hiki pe holoki ha meʻa.
- **Ngaahi taki:** ʻoku ʻi ai ha taki ʻa e poloseki kotoa pē. Ko ʻenau talanoa ko e founga vave taha ia ke ʻeke ha meʻa ki he timi ko ia taʻe faʻu ha kaati. Ko e tali kotoa pē ko ha ngāue ʻa e ʻeiseniti, ko ia ʻoku ngāueʻaki ai ha ngaahi token.
- **Kaumeʻa:** ʻoku fakalele ʻe ha kaumeʻa hono AI-gile ʻoʻona. ʻOku ʻalu hoʻomo ngaahi DM ʻi he vahaʻa ʻo hoʻomo ongo laupapa ʻo fakapuliki, pea ʻoku tauhi fakapuliki foki ʻi he komipiuta ni. ʻOku ngāue ʻa e ngaahi tali, ngaahi fakaʻilonga ongoʻi mo e ngaahi poini taipe hangē pē ko ha polokalama talanoa.
- **Ngaahi kulupu:** ko koe mo ha ʻeiseniti ʻe ua pe lahi ange, mei ha poloseki pē. Ko e fakamatala kotoa pē ʻoku ke tohi ʻoku ne ueʻi tuʻo taha ʻa e mēmipa taki taha ke tali, ko ia ʻoku ngāueʻaki ʻe ha kulupu lahi ʻa e token lahi ange.
- **Ngaahi potu fakataha:** taha ki he poloseki taki taha, mo e ngaahi ʻeiseniti ʻi heʻene timi ko e kau mēmipa, ʻoku foʻou maʻu ai pē. Ko e ui ʻi ha potu fakataha ʻoku maʻau pē: ʻoku ʻikai lava ke hū ki ai ʻa e kaumeʻa mo e ʻeiseniti.
- **Ngaahi ui:** ʻoku ngāue leva ʻa e ngaahi ui leʻo mo e vitiō ʻi he sēvā ui ʻa AI-gile pē, maʻau pea maʻa hoʻo kaumeʻa; ʻikai ha meʻa ke fokotuʻu. Ke ngāueʻaki hoʻo sēvā LiveKit ʻaʻau, fakaava ʻa e **Fokotuʻu → Ngaahi fetuʻutaki → Fakalahi**.
- **Vahevahe sikilini:** ʻi ha ui kiliki ʻi he **🖥️ Vahevahe ʻa e sikilini**; ʻoku ʻeke ʻe he palausa pe ko e sikilini fē, matapā fē pe tape fē. Kiliki ʻi he **🖥️ Tuku ʻa e vahevahe** ke tuku.
- **Maika, kāmera mo e sipika:** ʻoku ʻi ai ha meʻa fili ʻi he paneli ui ki he taha kotoa, ʻaonga mo ha headset pe ha kāmera ua.
- **ʻI he taimi ʻoku ʻikai ngāue ai ʻa e maika pe kāmera:** ko e "kuo poloka" ʻoku pehē ʻe he palausa ʻikai: fakaʻatā ia ʻi he laine ʻadresi. Ko e "ʻikai maʻu" ʻoku ʻikai fakahū pe fakaʻā ha meʻa. Ko e "ʻoku ngāueʻaki ʻe ha polokalama kehe" ʻoku piki ki ai ha polokalama ui kehe: tāpuni ia. ʻE lava pē ke ke fanongo maʻu ai pē.
- **Ko ha ui ʻoku motu:** ʻuluaki te ke sio ki he "ʻOku toe fehokotaki…". Kapau ʻoku ʻosi, sivi hoʻo initaneti pea toe ui.
- **Ngaahi angaʻitangata lelei:** ngāueʻaki ha kulupu pe ha potu fakataha ki ha fehuʻi ki ha ʻeiseniti lahi kae ʻikai kopi ia, fakalongolongo ʻi he taimi ʻoku ʻikai te ke lea ai, pea vahevahe ha matapā pē ʻe taha kae ʻikai ko e sikilini kotoa.
